question: How much is the employee referral bonus at Vellacourt Insurance?
answer: Vellacourt pays referring employees a $3,000 bonus for each referred hire.

sources.title: Vellacourt People Hub - Employee referral programme
sources.text:
Great colleagues often know other great people. Our referral programme thanks you for introducing candidates who go on to join Vellacourt Insurance.

Referral bonus
Vellacourt pays referring employees a $3,000 bonus for each referred hire who starts between 1 November 2026 and 28 February 2027. The bonus is added to your salary in the first payroll run after your referred colleague's start date and is taxed in the same way as your salary.

How to refer someone
Open the Careers page on the People Hub, find the role, and choose Refer a friend. Add the candidate's name, email address and CV, along with a few lines about why you think they would be a good fit. The candidate receives an email inviting them to complete their application. You can track the progress of each referral from the My referrals page, although interview feedback stays confidential.

Good practice
Only refer people you know and would be happy to work with. Ask the candidate before you share their details, and do not promise them an interview or an offer, because every referred candidate goes through the same selection process as other applicants. If you are on the interview panel for someone you referred, tell the Talent team so that they can arrange a replacement panel member.

sources.title: Vellacourt People Hub - Onboarding a new starter
sources.text:
A good first week makes a lasting difference. If someone is joining your team, these steps help them settle in quickly.

Before they arrive
The Talent team sends the new starter a welcome pack about two weeks before their first day. As their manager, add them to your team's calendar invitations and chat channels, and choose an onboarding buddy from the team. The IT team ships a laptop to their home address or leaves it at the reception of their office, depending on what they chose.

The first day
Plan to spend the first morning with your new starter. Introduce them to the team, walk them through the week's schedule and make sure they can sign in to their laptop and the People Hub. Vellacourt's company induction takes place on the first Tuesday of every month, and the Talent team books new starters onto the next available session.

The first 90 days
Agree three to five goals in the first two weeks and hold a short check-in each week. At 90 days, complete the probation review form on the People Hub together. Most probation periods end at 90 days, but they can be extended once by up to a further 90 days.

sources.title: Vellacourt People Hub - Interview panels
sources.text:
Every role at Vellacourt is filled through a structured interview, so that candidates are assessed fairly and on the same criteria.

Who sits on a panel
Each panel has two or three members: the hiring manager, a colleague from the team and, for senior roles, a member of the leadership group. At least one panel member must have completed the structured interviewing course in the last two years.

Preparing
The Talent team shares the interview questions and the scoring guide three days before the interview. Read the candidate's CV and application, but do not search for them on social media.

During the interview
Ask every candidate the same core questions, in the same order. You can ask follow-up questions to understand an answer better. Take notes as you go, focusing on what the candidate said and did rather than your impressions.

Scoring and feedback
Score each answer independently, before talking to the other panel members. Then meet as a panel to agree an overall decision. Submit scores and notes in the hiring system within 24 hours, so that the Talent team can give the candidate timely feedback.

question: What time do Quillfen studios close on Fridays?
answer: Between 4 June and 27 August 2027, Quillfen studios close at 1 p.m. on Fridays.

sources.title: Quillfen Staff Handbook - Annual leave
sources.text:
Everyone at Quillfen Architects receives 27 days of paid annual leave a year, plus public holidays, rising to 30 days after five years with the practice. The leave year runs from 1 April to 31 March.

Booking leave
Request leave in the HR system and copy in your project lead. Try to give at least four weeks' notice for anything longer than a week, and check the project calendar first so that you are not away during a planned submission or a key client presentation.

Sickness during leave
If you are ill during a period of annual leave, tell your line manager as soon as you can. Days of illness covered by a fit note can be reclaimed and taken as annual leave at another time.

Carrying over leave
Up to five days can be carried over into the next leave year with your project lead's agreement. Carried-over days must be used by 30 June.

Buying extra leave
Once a year, in March, you can buy up to five extra days of leave. The cost is spread across your salary payments for the following twelve months.

sources.title: Quillfen Staff Handbook - Professional registration and CPD
sources.text:
Quillfen supports architects, architectural assistants and technologists in gaining and keeping their professional registration.

Registration fees
The practice pays the annual registration fee and one professional institute membership for every member of staff who holds, or is working towards, a professional qualification. Submit the invoice to the finance team before the renewal date and they will pay it directly.

Continuing professional development
Registered architects must complete at least 35 hours of CPD each year. Quillfen runs a lunchtime CPD talk every other Wednesday, covering topics such as building regulations, fire safety, sustainable materials and contract law. Talks are recorded and saved to the learning library for anyone who cannot attend.

Study leave for qualifications
If you are studying for Part 2 or Part 3, you can take up to ten days of paid study leave a year for exams and submissions, in addition to annual leave. Agree the dates with your project lead as early as you can.

Keeping records
Log your CPD hours in the HR system. Your line manager reviews them with you at your mid-year conversation.

sources.title: Quillfen Staff Handbook - Summer Fridays
sources.text:
Summer Fridays give everyone at Quillfen time to enjoy the long evenings while the weather is good.

Between 4 June and 27 August 2027, Quillfen studios close at 1 p.m. on Fridays. The closed afternoons are paid and do not count against your annual leave.

Client commitments
Project deadlines, site visits and client meetings still come first. If a planning hearing, site inspection or client presentation is booked for a Friday afternoon during this period, your project lead will agree with you who needs to attend. Anyone who works a Friday afternoon during the period can take the same number of hours off on another day within four weeks, agreed with their project lead.

Part-time staff
If you do not normally work on Fridays, you can take an equivalent half day on another day in the same week, agreed with your project lead.

Getting into the building
The studio buildings are locked from 1.30 p.m. on these Fridays, and the alarm is set at 2 p.m. If you need to collect drawings or models after that time, ask the office manager in advance for an out-of-hours pass. Remote access to the project server and email is available as usual.

question: Can I get a refund on my Lyrabeck subscription?
answer: Lyrabeck refunds an annual Premium subscription in full.

sources.title: Lyrabeck Help - Downloading lessons for offline use
sources.text:
With Lyrabeck Premium you can download lessons and practise without an internet connection, which is handy on flights, in the underground or anywhere with patchy signal.

How to download
Open a course, tap the unit you want, then tap the download arrow next to the unit title. You can download a whole unit at once or individual lessons. Downloaded lessons show a small filled circle on the course map. Audio, images and the pronunciation coach's example recordings are all saved to your device.

Storage
A typical unit takes between 40 and 90 MB. To see how much space your downloads use, go to Settings, then Storage. You can delete a single unit by swiping left on it, or remove everything with Clear all downloads.

Keeping your progress in sync
Lessons you complete offline are saved on your device and uploaded to your account the next time you connect. If you study on more than one device, connect each one at least once a week so your streak and review schedule stay accurate across all of them. Speaking exercises completed offline are scored when you reconnect, so your score for those may appear a little later than usual.

sources.title: Lyrabeck Help - Changing your course language
sources.text:
You can study more than one language on Lyrabeck, and you can switch between them whenever you like. Progress in each language is kept separately, so switching never resets anything.

Adding a new language
Tap the flag at the top of the Learn tab, then tap Add a language. Choose the language you want to learn and the language you want instructions in. Lyrabeck currently offers 18 courses taught from English and 9 taught from Spanish. A short placement quiz suggests where to start, or you can begin from the first unit.

Switching between languages
Tap the flag and choose the language you want to study today. Your daily goal applies to all your languages combined, so a lesson in any of them counts towards your streak.

Removing a language
If you no longer want a course, tap the flag, then Edit, then the minus sign next to the language. Removing a course hides it from your list but does not delete your progress. If you add the same course again later, you will return to the unit you reached.

sources.title: Lyrabeck Help - Refunds
sources.text:
Lyrabeck Premium unlocks every course, the pronunciation coach and offline lessons. You can pay for Premium monthly or annually, and you can cancel at any time from Account, then Subscription.

Asking for a refund
Lyrabeck refunds an annual Premium subscription in full if you request the refund within 14 days of the purchase date. To ask for one, open Account, then Billing, and tap Request a refund next to the payment. We will ask you for a reason, but your answer does not affect the decision. You will receive an email confirming the refund, usually within one business day.

Where the money goes
Refunds are returned to the card or digital wallet you paid with. Most banks show the money in your account within five to ten business days, although some take longer around public holidays. If the card you used has since expired or been cancelled, your bank will normally pass the refund to your new card or account automatically.

What happens to your progress
Once a refund is issued, your account moves to the free plan straight away. Your streaks, course progress and saved vocabulary lists are kept, so you can pick up where you left off if you subscribe again later. Lessons you downloaded for offline use are removed from your devices the next time the app connects to the internet.

question: How much paid parental leave does Harrowmede Logistics give employees?
answer: Employees receive 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave.

sources.title: Harrowmede Employee Handbook - 7.2 Parental leave
sources.text:
Harrowmede Logistics supports employees who are welcoming a child through birth, adoption or surrogacy. This section explains how much leave is available, how to request it, and what continues while you are away.

How much leave you can take
Employees receive 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave if they have completed 12 months of continuous service by the expected date of birth or placement. You can take parental leave in one block or in up to three separate blocks, as long as all of it is used before the child's first birthday or the first anniversary of the placement. If both parents work for Harrowmede, they may take leave at the same time.

Requesting leave
Tell your line manager and the People team in writing at least eight weeks before you want your leave to start. Use the Parental Leave form on the People Hub and attach the expected due date, or the placement date confirmed by your adoption or surrogacy agency. If the date changes, update the form as soon as you can.

While you are away
Your pension contributions, life cover and private medical insurance continue during parental leave, and you keep accruing annual leave at your normal rate. You may work up to ten Keeping in Touch days, paid at your normal daily rate, without bringing your leave to an end. Your manager will agree with you in advance how you would like to be contacted.

sources.title: Harrowmede Employee Handbook - 7.1 Annual leave
sources.text:
Full-time employees at Harrowmede Logistics receive 25 days of paid annual leave each holiday year, plus public holidays. The holiday year runs from 1 January to 31 December. Part-time employees receive a pro rata entitlement based on their contracted hours, which the People team calculates and shows on the People Hub.

Booking leave
Request leave through the People Hub at least two weeks before the first day you want off. Your line manager will approve or decline within five working days. During peak season, from mid-November to the end of December, depot and warehouse teams may have limits on how many people can be away at once, so book early.

Carrying leave over
You can carry up to five unused days into the next holiday year. Carried-over days must be used by 31 March or they are lost. If you could not take leave because of sickness or family leave, speak to the People team, as different carry-over rules may apply.

Leaving Harrowmede
If you leave part way through the year, you will be paid for any leave you have accrued but not taken. If you have taken more leave than you have accrued, the difference is deducted from your final pay.

sources.title: Harrowmede Employee Handbook - 7.4 Bereavement leave
sources.text:
Losing someone close is hard, and work should be the last thing on your mind. Harrowmede gives employees time away to grieve, make arrangements and attend a funeral or memorial.

How much leave
You can take up to ten working days of paid bereavement leave following the death of a partner, child, parent, sibling, grandparent or grandchild, or anyone you lived with as part of your household. For the death of another relative or a close friend, you can take up to three working days of paid leave. The days do not need to be taken together, and you can use some of them later, for example to attend a memorial service or to deal with the estate.

Pregnancy loss
If you or your partner experience a miscarriage or stillbirth at any stage of pregnancy, you can take up to ten working days of paid leave.

How to request it
Let your line manager know as soon as you feel able to, by phone, message or email. You do not need to provide a death certificate or any other evidence. If your manager is not available, contact the People team directly, who will make sure your shifts or deliveries are covered.

gold_spans.quote: Employees receive 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave if they have completed 12 months of continuous service by the expected date of birth or placement.

gold.dropped_qualifier: if they have completed 12 months of continuous service by the expected date of birth or placement

You can carry up to five unused days into the next holiday year. Carried-over days must be used by 31 March or they are lost. If you could not take leave because of sickness or family leave, speak to the People team, as different carry-over rules may apply.

Leaving Harrowmede
If you leave part way through the year, you will be paid for any leave you have accrued but not taken. If you have taken more leave than you have accrued, the difference is deducted from your final pay.

sources.title: Harrowmede Employee Handbook - 7.4 Bereavement leave
sources.text:
Losing someone close is hard, and work should be the last thing on your mind. Harrowmede gives employees time away to grieve, make arrangements and attend a funeral or memorial.

How much leave
You can take up to ten working days of paid bereavement leave following the death of a partner, child, parent, sibling, grandparent or grandchild, or anyone you lived with as part of your household. For the death of another relative or a close friend, you can take up to three working days of paid leave. The days do not need to be taken together, and you can use some of them later, for example to attend a memorial service or to deal with the estate.

Pregnancy loss
If you or your partner experience a miscarriage or stillbirth at any stage of pregnancy, you can take up to ten working days of paid leave.

How to request it
Let your line manager know as soon as you feel able to, by phone, message or email. You do not need to provide a death certificate or any other evidence. If your manager is not available, contact the People team directly, who will make sure your shifts or deliveries are covered.

question: Will Kestrova Studios pay for a course I want to take?
answer: Kestrova reimburses tuition for an approved course up to $5,250 per calendar year.

sources.title: Kestrova Studios Handbook - Conference attendance
sources.text:
Industry events are a great way to see new work, meet other studios and bring fresh ideas back to your team. Each team at Kestrova has a conference budget, set at the start of the financial year, which the team lead manages.

Asking to attend
Talk to your team lead about the event, what you hope to learn, and how it fits with current project deadlines. If they agree, they will book your ticket through the studio's events account so that you do not have to pay anything up front. Travel and hotels are booked through the travel desk in the usual way.

Speaking at an event
If you have been invited to speak or to show your work, let the Communications team know at least four weeks before the event. They can help with slides, check that any client work you plan to show has been cleared for public use, and promote your session on Kestrova's channels.

Sharing what you learned
Within two weeks of returning, share a short write-up or a ten-minute talk with your team. Most people choose to present at the Friday studio show-and-tell. Write-ups are saved to the Learning library so that colleagues who could not attend can benefit too.

sources.title: Kestrova Studios Handbook - Tuition assistance
sources.text:
Kestrova Studios wants everyone to keep building their skills, whether that means a short certificate in motion graphics or a part-time degree. The tuition assistance programme helps with the cost.

What is covered
Kestrova reimburses tuition for an approved course up to $5,250 per calendar year if you complete the course with a passing grade. A course is approved when it relates to your current role, or to a role you could reasonably move into at Kestrova, and it is offered by an accredited college, university or recognised professional body. Tuition and mandatory course fees count towards the annual amount. Textbooks, software licences and travel do not.

How to apply
Submit a Tuition Request in the People portal at least 30 days before the course begins. Your manager reviews the request first, then the Learning team checks the course against the approval criteria. You will usually receive a decision by email within ten working days.

Claiming your reimbursement
When the course ends, upload your receipts and your final grade report or certificate to the same Tuition Request. The Learning team checks the documents, and the reimbursement is added to the next monthly pay run. Reimbursements are paid in US dollars; if you paid in another currency, the exchange rate on the day the Learning team approves the claim is used.

sources.title: Kestrova Studios Handbook - Mentoring programme
sources.text:
The Kestrova mentoring programme pairs people who want to grow in a particular direction with experienced colleagues from a different team. Mentoring is voluntary, and it sits alongside the support you get from your manager rather than replacing it.

Joining as a mentee
Sign-ups open twice a year, in March and September. Fill in the short form on the People portal describing what you would like help with, such as moving into art direction, building client confidence or learning a new tool. The Learning team matches you with a mentor within three weeks.

Becoming a mentor
Anyone who has been at Kestrova for at least two years can volunteer as a mentor. Mentors attend a two-hour introductory workshop and are encouraged to meet their mentee at least once a month for six months.

Ending a mentoring pair
Either person can end the arrangement at any time by letting the Learning team know. There is no need to give a reason. If a pairing is not working, the Learning team will happily find you a different match.

question: Can I call regular phone numbers from my Halvorn speaker?
answer: Hands-free calling to landlines and mobile numbers is available to Halvorn customers.

sources.title: Halvorn Help - Setting up multi-room audio
sources.text:
If you have more than one Halvorn speaker, you can group them so the same music plays in several rooms at once, perfectly in sync.

Creating a group
Open the Halvorn Home app and tap Rooms. Tap Create group, choose the speakers you want to include, and give the group a name such as Downstairs or Whole house. A speaker can belong to more than one group, but it can only play one stream at a time.

Playing music to a group
Say the wake phrase followed by the name of the song and the group, for example "play some jazz in Downstairs". In the app, choose the group as the output before you press play. Volume can be set for the whole group or for each speaker individually.

Tips for a stable connection
Every speaker in a group must be on the same Wi-Fi network. If music drops out on one speaker, move it closer to your router or add a mesh point. Groups work best with up to eight speakers. If a speaker has been unplugged, it rejoins its groups automatically when it reconnects.

sources.title: Halvorn Help - Voice profiles
sources.text:
Voice profiles let your Halvorn speaker recognise who is talking, so it can give each person in your home their own calendar, reminders and music recommendations.

Creating a voice profile
Open the Halvorn Home app, tap your account picture, then tap Voice profile. You will be asked to read six short phrases aloud in a quiet room. It takes about two minutes. Each person who wants a profile needs their own Halvorn account, and up to six profiles can be linked to one home.

What changes when a profile is set up
When the speaker recognises you, it reads your own calendar events and reminders and plays from your music library and playlists. If it does not recognise the voice, it answers general questions but will not read out personal information.

Removing a profile
Go to the same Voice profile screen and tap Delete profile. Your voice data is deleted from Halvorn's servers within 30 days. Removing a profile does not delete your Halvorn account or your music library.

sources.title: Halvorn Help - Calling with your Halvorn speaker
sources.text:
Your Halvorn speaker can do more than play music. You can call other Halvorn speakers in your contacts, and Drop In lets you talk to another speaker in your own home without anyone having to answer.

Calling phone numbers
Hands-free calling to landlines and mobile numbers is available to Halvorn customers in Canada and the United Kingdom. To set it up, open the Halvorn Home app, tap your speaker, then tap Calling and follow the prompts to link your mobile number. When a call connects, the person you are calling sees your linked mobile number as the caller ID.

Making and ending a call
Say the wake phrase followed by "call" and a contact's name, or read out the number digit by digit. The light ring turns green while a call is in progress. To hang up, say "end call" or tap the top of the speaker.

Drop In
Drop In works between speakers that are signed in to the same Halvorn account. Each speaker plays a short tone before a Drop In connects, and you can switch Drop In off for any speaker under Settings, then Communication.

Privacy
Press the microphone button to mute the microphones at any time. The light ring turns red while they are muted, and the speaker will not respond to the wake phrase or receive calls until you press the button again.

gold_spans.quote: Hands-free calling to landlines and mobile numbers is available to Halvorn customers in Canada and the United Kingdom.

gold.dropped_qualifier: in Canada and the United Kingdom

construction.note: Deleted only the region scope; S3 states availability for customers in Canada and the United Kingdom and says nothing about other countries, so availability to all customers is unsupported.

question: Does Quorrel Foods give employees money towards their phone bill?
answer: Employees receive a monthly mobile phone stipend of $60.

sources.title: Quorrel Foods People Handbook - Company vehicles
sources.text:
Some roles at Quorrel come with a company vehicle, either a car for travelling between customer sites or a van for deliveries and merchandising. Your offer letter tells you whether your role includes one.

Before you drive
You must hold a full driving licence valid in the country where you will drive, and you must have shown the original to the fleet team. The fleet team checks licences every six months. Tell your manager straight away if you receive penalty points or a driving ban.

Fuel and charging
Each vehicle comes with a fuel or charging card. Use it only for the vehicle it belongs to. Private mileage in a company car is allowed, but it is recorded and may affect the tax you pay.

Accidents and breakdowns
If you are involved in an accident, make sure everyone is safe first, then call the 24-hour fleet helpline printed on the key fob. Do not admit liability at the scene. Report every accident, however minor, within 24 hours.

Looking after the vehicle
Keep the vehicle clean and book it in for servicing when the dashboard reminder appears.

sources.title: Quorrel Foods People Handbook - Business travel
sources.text:
When you travel for Quorrel, book flights, trains and hotels through the travel portal so that we can find you quickly if something goes wrong while you are away.

Booking
Book at least 14 days ahead where you can. Economy class is standard for all flights. For journeys by train, standard class is the default, but first class can be booked if the journey is over three hours and you need to work on the way. Hotels should be within the nightly limits shown in the portal for each city.

Using your own car
If you drive your own car on business, claim mileage through the expenses system. Keep a note of the start and end points and the purpose of each trip. Mileage covers fuel and wear and tear, so you cannot claim fuel separately.

Meals
While travelling overnight, you can claim up to $55 a day for meals. Keep itemised receipts. Alcohol cannot be claimed.

Claiming expenses
Submit claims within 60 days of the expense. Claims approved by your manager are paid with your next salary payment.

sources.title: Quorrel Foods People Handbook - Mobile phones
sources.text:
Many colleagues rely on their own phones to stay in touch with stores, distributors and customers while they are out and about. This section explains how phone costs are handled and what we expect when you use your phone for work.

Phone stipend
Employees in the Sales and Customer Success departments receive a monthly mobile phone stipend of $60. The stipend is added to your salary payment on the last working day of each month and appears on your payslip as Mobile Allowance. It is treated as taxable income in the same way as your salary.

You choose your own handset, network and plan. Quorrel does not pay for the cost of buying a phone.

Using your phone for work
Install the Quorrel Workspace app before you access work email or chat on your phone. The app keeps work data in a separate, encrypted area, which the IT team can wipe remotely if your phone is lost or you leave Quorrel. IT cannot see your personal photos, messages or browsing.

Lost or stolen phones
Report a lost or stolen phone to the IT service desk straight away, at any time of day, so that work data can be removed.

gold.dropped_qualifier: in the Sales and Customer Success departments

question: How long do I have to return a Pagewyn e-reader?
answer: Pagewyn e-readers can be returned within 60 days of delivery.

sources.title: Pagewyn Help - Holiday returns
sources.text:
Buying a Pagewyn e-reader as a present? Here is how holiday returns work, including returns made by the person who received the gift.

Pagewyn e-readers ordered between 1 November and 31 December 2026 can be returned within 60 days of delivery. This covers every Pagewyn e-reader model, including bundles that come with a cover or a charging dock. The person returning the e-reader does not need the order confirmation; the serial number on the back of the device is enough for us to find the order.

How to send it back
Sign in to your Pagewyn account, open Orders, then choose Return an item. If you received the e-reader as a gift, choose Gift return on the Help page instead and enter the serial number. Either way, you will get a prepaid shipping label by email. Pack the e-reader securely, ideally in its original box, and drop it at any parcel point listed on the label.

Refunds and gift returns
Once the e-reader reaches our returns centre and passes a quick check, we refund the original payment method. Gift recipients can choose a Pagewyn store credit instead, so the person who bought the present is not told about the return. Refunds and credits are usually issued within five business days of the e-reader arriving.

sources.title: Pagewyn Help - Sending documents to your e-reader
sources.text:
You can read your own documents on a Pagewyn e-reader as well as books from the Pagewyn store. Documents you send are stored in your Pagewyn library, so they appear on every e-reader and in every reading app signed in to your account.

Sending by email
Every Pagewyn account has a personal send-to address, shown under Settings, then Documents in the Pagewyn app. Attach a file to an email and send it to that address from an email account you have approved on the same screen. Files arrive on your e-reader the next time it connects to Wi-Fi.

Supported files
You can send EPUB, PDF, DOCX, TXT and RTF files, as well as JPEG and PNG images, up to 50 MB each. EPUB and DOCX files are converted so that you can change the font size and layout. PDFs keep their original layout, which works best for documents with complex formatting.

Using the desktop app
On a computer, drag files onto the Pagewyn desktop app window, or connect the e-reader with a USB-C cable and copy files into the Documents folder. Files copied over USB stay on that device only and are not added to your library.

sources.title: Pagewyn Help - Battery life and charging
sources.text:
A Pagewyn e-reader can last for weeks on a single charge, because the screen uses power only when the page changes. How long it lasts for you depends on how you read.

What affects battery life
Front light brightness, Wi-Fi, page-turn animations and audiobook playback all use extra power. On average, reading for 30 minutes a day with Wi-Fi off and the light at the middle setting, a full charge lasts about six weeks. Listening to audiobooks over Bluetooth uses the battery much faster.

Charging
Use the USB-C cable that came with your e-reader and any USB charger rated at 5 volts. A full charge takes about two and a half hours. Models with wireless charging can also be placed on a Qi-certified pad or the Pagewyn charging dock. The battery icon at the top of the screen shows a lightning bolt while charging.

Saving power
Turn on Battery saver in Settings to switch off Wi-Fi when you are not downloading books. If you will not read for several weeks, charge the e-reader to about half and turn it off completely by holding the power button for five seconds.

Front light brightness, Wi-Fi, page-turn animations and audiobook playback all use extra power. On average, reading for 30 minutes a day with Wi-Fi off and the light at the middle setting, a full charge lasts about six weeks. Listening to audiobooks over Bluetooth uses the battery much faster.

Charging
Use the USB-C cable that came with your e-reader and any USB charger rated at 5 volts. A full charge takes about two and a half hours. Models with wireless charging can also be placed on a Qi-certified pad or the Pagewyn charging dock. The battery icon at the top of the screen shows a lightning bolt while charging.

Saving power
Turn on Battery saver in Settings to switch off Wi-Fi when you are not downloading books. If you will not read for several weeks, charge the e-reader to about half and turn it off completely by holding the power button for five seconds.

question: Does Quarrybrook Health Plan give members a credit toward their annual deductible?
answer: Quarrybrook credits $150 toward your annual deductible.

sources.title: Quarrybrook Health Plan - How your deductible works
sources.text:
Your deductible is the amount you pay for covered services each plan year before Quarrybrook starts to share the cost. On the Quarrybrook Choice plan, the deductible is $1,800 for an individual and $3,600 for a family. The plan year runs from 1 January to 31 December.

Some services are covered before you meet your deductible. Preventive care, such as your annual physical, routine immunizations and recommended cancer screenings, is covered at no cost when you see an in-network provider. Primary care office visits have a $25 copay from the first visit of the year, and that copay does not count toward the deductible.

Once you have met your deductible, you pay 20% coinsurance for most covered services until you reach the out-of-pocket maximum of $6,500 for an individual or $13,000 for a family. After that, Quarrybrook pays 100% of covered in-network services for the rest of the plan year.

On a family plan, each person's spending counts toward the family deductible, and no one person pays more than the individual deductible amount. You can see how much of your deductible you have met on the deductible tracker in your member account.

sources.title: Quarrybrook Health Plan - The Wellness Check
sources.text:
The Wellness Check is a short online questionnaire about your health history, sleep, physical activity and any ongoing conditions. Most members finish it in about 15 minutes. You will find it under My Health in your Quarrybrook member account and in the Quarrybrook mobile app.

Your answers are confidential. We use them to suggest programs that may help you, such as sleep coaching or the Steps Together walking group, and to let a nurse know if a follow-up call might be useful. Your answers are never shared with your employer, and they never affect your premium or whether a claim is paid.

Deductible credit
Quarrybrook credits $150 toward your annual deductible if you complete the Wellness Check questionnaire within 60 days of your coverage start date. The credit shows on the deductible tracker in your member account within 10 business days, and it counts toward your deductible in the same way as an amount you have paid yourself.

If you have questions about the Wellness Check, send us a secure message from your member account or call Member Services at the number on the back of your ID card, Monday to Friday, 8 am to 8 pm.

sources.title: Quarrybrook Health Plan - Sleep coaching
sources.text:
Poor sleep can make almost every health condition harder to manage. Quarrybrook's sleep coaching program pairs you with a certified sleep coach for six video sessions over about three months.

In the first session, your coach reviews a two-week sleep diary that you keep in the Quarrybrook app, and together you agree on one or two changes to try first, such as a fixed wake-up time or a wind-down routine. Later sessions look at what is working and adjust the plan. Coaches do not prescribe medication, but they can suggest that you talk to your doctor if your diary points to a condition such as sleep apnea.

Sleep coaching sessions are covered at no cost to you and do not need a referral. To get started, open the Quarrybrook app, go to My Health, then Programs, and choose Sleep coaching. You can book sessions in the early morning or the evening to fit around work, and you can change or cancel a session up to 24 hours before it starts.

question: Does Ostrel Family Health Plans cover visits to an out-of-network specialist?
answer: Ostrel covers visits to an out-of-network specialist you were already seeing at the in-network cost share.

sources.title: Ostrel Family Health Plans - Transition of care for new members
sources.text:
Changing health plans can mean changing doctors, but it should not mean stopping treatment partway through. Our transition of care benefit helps new members keep seeing the specialists who already know their history while they get to know the Ostrel network.

Seeing your current specialist
During the first 90 days after your coverage start date, Ostrel covers visits to an out-of-network specialist you were already seeing at the in-network cost share. This means you pay the same copay or coinsurance as you would for a network specialist, and the amounts you pay count toward your in-network deductible and out-of-pocket maximum.

Telling us about your care
It helps to tell us which specialists you see. You can list them on the Current Care form in your member account, and a care coordinator will call you to answer questions about your treatment and your coverage.

Billing
Your current specialist does not need to sign a contract with Ostrel. We will send them a short letter explaining how to bill us, and they can call our provider line if they have questions.

sources.title: Ostrel Family Health Plans - Seeing a specialist
sources.text:
Ostrel plans do not require a referral to see a specialist in the Ostrel network. You can book directly with a dermatologist, cardiologist, orthopedic surgeon or any other network specialist, although your primary care provider can still help you choose one.

To find a network specialist, use the Find Care tool in your member account. You can search by specialty, distance, languages spoken and whether the specialist is accepting new patients. Each listing shows the specialist's hospital affiliations and any other offices where they see patients.

A visit to a network specialist has a $45 copay on the Ostrel Family Silver plan and a $30 copay on the Ostrel Family Gold plan. Tests and procedures done during the visit, such as an X-ray or a skin biopsy, may have their own cost share.

Before your first appointment, call the specialist's office to confirm that they are still in the Ostrel network. Networks can change during the year, and the Find Care tool is updated weekly.

question: How long do I have to return something I bought from Gildmoor Kitchenware?
answer: The return window is 60 days from delivery.

sources.title: Gildmoor Kitchenware - Caring for carbon steel pans
sources.text:
Carbon steel pans heat quickly, last for decades and become more non-stick the more you cook with them. They need a little more care than stainless steel, but the routine is simple.

Before first use, wash the pan in hot soapy water to remove the protective wax coating applied at the factory, dry it completely, and season it: wipe a very thin layer of neutral oil over the inside, then heat the pan on the hob until it stops smoking. Repeat this two or three times. The surface will turn brown and then black over the first few months of use, which is normal.

After cooking, rinse the pan with hot water and scrub off any stuck food with a brush. Dry it over a low heat and rub in a drop of oil while it is still warm. Avoid soaking the pan or putting it in the dishwasher, because both cause rust.

If rust does appear, scrub it off with steel wool, rinse, dry, and season the pan again.

sources.title: Gildmoor Kitchenware - Holiday gifting 2026
sources.text:
Buying a gift is easier when you know it can go back if it is not quite right. Here is what you need to know about gifts bought from Gildmoor this holiday season.

Return window
For purchases made between 1 November and 31 December 2026, the return window is 60 days from delivery. To start a return, enter your order number and email address on the Returns page, and we will email you a label for the parcel.

Gift receipts
Add a gift receipt at checkout and we will leave the prices off the packing slip. The person you give the gift to can use the gift receipt to return it for a Gildmoor gift card, and the return will not be refunded to your payment card.

Last order dates
To receive your order before 24 December, order by 16 December for standard delivery or by 21 December for express delivery. Engraved knives and personalised chopping boards take three extra working days, so please order them by 11 December.

question: Does the Calderwyn Benefit Plan cover prescription eyeglasses?
answer: One pair of prescription eyeglasses is covered in full each plan year.

sources.title: Calderwyn Benefit Plan - Adding a dependent
sources.text:
You can add your spouse or domestic partner and your children to your Calderwyn Benefit Plan coverage. Children can stay on the plan until the end of the month in which they turn 26, whether or not they live with you, are in school or are married.

You can add dependents during the annual enrollment period each November. Outside that period, you can add a dependent within 31 days of a qualifying life event, such as a marriage, the birth or adoption of a child, or your partner losing other coverage. Coverage for a newborn starts from the date of birth as long as you add the baby within the 31 days.

To add a dependent, sign in to the benefits portal, choose Life events, and upload the document that confirms the event, such as a marriage certificate or birth certificate. The benefits team reviews documents within five business days, and new ID cards arrive by mail about a week after approval.

Adding a dependent can change the amount taken from your paycheck. The portal shows the new amount before you confirm.

sources.title: Calderwyn Benefit Plan - Vision benefits
sources.text:
The Calderwyn Benefit Plan includes vision benefits, so you do not need to enroll in a separate vision plan. You do not need a referral to see an optometrist.

Eye exams
Routine eye exams are covered for members of all ages once every plan year, with a $10 copay. The exam includes a check of your eye health and, if you need it, an updated prescription for glasses.

Eyeglasses
For covered children under age 19, one pair of prescription eyeglasses is covered in full each plan year. This includes both the frames and the lenses, and the lenses come with a scratch-resistant coating at no extra cost.

Using your benefit
Show your Calderwyn member ID card when you book your exam and again at the appointment. The optometrist's office will bill the plan directly, so there is no claim form to fill in. If you have questions about what your visit will cost, call Member Services before your appointment.

question: Do I have to pay return postage to send back a Fernquill Paper Co. order?
answer: Return postage is free.

sources.title: Fernquill Paper Co. - Returning an order
sources.text:
If something you ordered from Fernquill is not quite right, you can send it back within 30 days of delivery for a refund to your original payment method. Please keep notebooks in their wrapping until you are sure you want to keep them, because we can only accept items back in the condition they arrived in.

Return postage
For orders delivered to addresses in the United Kingdom, return postage is free. UK customers can start a return from the Orders page of their Fernquill account and will receive a prepaid label by email, which can be printed at home or shown on a phone at a post office counter.

Refunds
We check returned items within three working days of receiving them. Once a return has been checked, we send the refund straight away, and your bank may take a further three to five working days to show it.

Personalised items
Notebooks and cards that have been embossed or printed with a name cannot be returned unless they arrive damaged or with a printing mistake.

sources.title: Fernquill Paper Co. - Delivery
sources.text:
Every Fernquill order is packed by hand in our studio, wrapped in tissue and posted in a recyclable box. Orders placed before 1 pm on a working day are posted the same day.

We deliver to addresses in the United Kingdom and to more than 40 other countries, including every country in the European Union, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand and Japan. UK standard delivery takes two to three working days and costs GBP 3.50, or nothing for orders over GBP 40. UK next-day delivery costs GBP 6.95 for orders placed before 1 pm.

International orders are sent by tracked airmail and usually arrive within five to ten working days. The delivery charge is calculated at checkout from the weight of your parcel and the destination. Orders sent outside the UK may be charged import duties or taxes by the destination country, and these are collected by the carrier before delivery.

If your parcel has not arrived within 15 working days of posting, email us and we will trace it.

question: Does Driftmoor charge extra when I pay by card in another currency?
answer: Card payments in a foreign currency are converted at the network exchange rate with no Driftmoor markup.

sources.title: Driftmoor - Using your card abroad
sources.text:
Your Driftmoor debit card can be used in shops, restaurants and online wherever the card network's logo is shown, in more than 150 countries. You do not need to tell us before you travel, but please check that your phone number is up to date in the app so that we can reach you if a payment looks unusual.

Between 1 November 2026 and 31 January 2027, card payments in a foreign currency are converted at the network exchange rate with no Driftmoor markup. Each payment appears in your transaction list in the local currency, alongside the amount in US dollars that was taken from your balance.

Pay in the local currency
If a card machine or website asks whether you want to pay in US dollars or in the local currency, choose the local currency. If you choose dollars, the shop's own provider converts the amount, often at a worse rate, and we cannot refund the difference.

Cash abroad
You can withdraw up to $400 a day from cash machines abroad. Some machine operators add their own fee, which should be shown on screen before you confirm the withdrawal.

If your card is lost abroad
Freeze your card straight away in the app. You can keep paying with your phone using your digital card while a replacement is posted to your home address.

sources.title: Driftmoor - Joint accounts
sources.text:
A Driftmoor joint account is shared by two people. Both of you can see every transaction, pay in money, make payments and order a card in your own name. It works well for paying household bills and shared costs.

Opening a joint account
One of you starts the application in the Driftmoor app under Accounts > Open a joint account and invites the other person by phone number. Both of you need a personal Driftmoor account first, and both need to be at least 18 years old. The account opens once the second person accepts the invitation and confirms their identity.

Who is responsible
Each account holder is responsible for the whole balance of a joint account, not just their own spending. If the account goes below zero, we can ask either of you to repay the full amount.

Leaving a joint account
Either person can ask to leave. Before the account can be closed, you will need to agree how to split the remaining balance, and any regular payments will need to be moved to another account. If you cannot agree, the account will be frozen until you do or until we receive a court order.

Notifications
Both of you receive a notification for every payment in or out of the joint account. You can turn these off for yourself without affecting the other person.

sources.title: Driftmoor - Sending money to friends
sources.text:
You can send money instantly to anyone who has a Driftmoor account, using their phone number, their Driftmoor tag or a QR code from their app. Payments between Driftmoor accounts are free and usually arrive within seconds.

Paying someone without Driftmoor
If your friend does not have a Driftmoor account, you can send them a payment link by text message or email. They can collect the money into any US bank account by entering their account details within 7 days. If the link is not used within 7 days, the money is returned to you.

Splitting a bill
After you pay for something with your card, open the transaction and tap Split. Choose who to split it with and whether to split evenly or by amount. Each person receives a request they can pay in one tap.

Requesting money
You can send a request to any Driftmoor user from the Payments screen. Requests that are not paid within 30 days expire automatically.

Limits
You can send up to $2,500 a day to other people. If you need to send more, you can make a bank transfer from the Payments screen instead.

sources.title: Driftmoor - Using your card abroad
sources.text:
Your Driftmoor debit card can be used in shops, restaurants and online wherever the card network's logo is shown, in more than 150 countries. You do not need to tell us before you travel, but please check that your phone number is up to date in the app so that we can reach you if a payment looks unusual.

Between 1 November 2026 and 31 January 2027, card payments in a foreign currency are converted at the network exchange rate with no Driftmoor markup. Each payment appears in your transaction list in the local currency, alongside the amount in US dollars that was taken from your balance.

Pay in the local currency
If a card machine or website asks whether you want to pay in US dollars or in the local currency, choose the local currency. If you choose dollars, the shop's own provider converts the amount, often at a worse rate, and we cannot refund the difference.

Cash abroad
You can withdraw up to $400 a day from cash machines abroad. Some machine operators add their own fee, which should be shown on screen before you confirm the withdrawal.

If your card is lost abroad
Freeze your card straight away in the app. You can keep paying with your phone using your digital card while a replacement is posted to your home address.

sources.title: Driftmoor - Joint accounts
sources.text:
A Driftmoor joint account is shared by two people. Both of you can see every transaction, pay in money, make payments and order a card in your own name. It works well for paying household bills and shared costs.

Opening a joint account
One of you starts the application in the Driftmoor app under Accounts > Open a joint account and invites the other person by phone number. Both of you need a personal Driftmoor account first, and both need to be at least 18 years old. The account opens once the second person accepts the invitation and confirms their identity.

Who is responsible
Each account holder is responsible for the whole balance of a joint account, not just their own spending. If the account goes below zero, we can ask either of you to repay the full amount.

Leaving a joint account
Either person can ask to leave. Before the account can be closed, you will need to agree how to split the remaining balance, and any regular payments will need to be moved to another account. If you cannot agree, the account will be frozen until you do or until we receive a court order.

Notifications
Both of you receive a notification for every payment in or out of the joint account. You can turn these off for yourself without affecting the other person.

question: Is a checked bag included with my Skelvane Air ticket?
answer: Every Skelvane Air ticket includes one free checked bag of up to 23 kg.

sources.title: Skelvane Air - Cabin bags
sources.text:
Every Skelvane Air passenger can bring one small personal item on board, such as a handbag, laptop bag or small backpack. It must fit under the seat in front of you and be no larger than 40 x 30 x 15 cm.

Cabin bags
You can also bring one cabin bag for the overhead locker, up to 55 x 40 x 20 cm and 10 kg, including handles and wheels. On busy flights, we may ask some passengers to leave their cabin bag at the gate. These bags are labelled and returned to you at the baggage reclaim belt.

Liquids
Liquids in your cabin bag must be in containers of 100 ml or less, packed together in one clear, resealable bag of up to 1 litre. Medicines and baby food needed during the flight are allowed in larger amounts.

Power banks and batteries
Power banks and spare lithium batteries must be carried in your cabin bag or personal item. Each passenger can carry up to two power banks of up to 100 Wh each.

Duty-free shopping
Items bought in the airport after security can be carried on board in addition to your cabin bag, as long as they fit in one shopping bag.

sources.title: Skelvane Air - Checked bags
sources.text:
Checked bags are dropped off at the bag drop desk after you check in online, or at the check-in desk if you check in at the airport. Bag drop closes 45 minutes before departure, and we cannot accept bags after that time.

For travel between 1 December 2026 and 15 January 2027, every Skelvane Air ticket includes one free checked bag of up to 23 kg. The bag can measure up to 158 cm when you add together its length, width and height, including handles and wheels.

Heavy bags
Bags weighing more than 23 kg are accepted up to a maximum of 32 kg, and must have a heavy-bag label attached at the desk so that baggage handlers know to take care when lifting them. No single bag can weigh more than 32 kg.

Sports equipment
Skis, golf clubs and bicycles can be checked in, but they must be packed in a dedicated bag or box. Bicycles must have the pedals removed and the handlebars turned sideways.

What not to pack
Keep valuables, keys, medicines and electronic devices in your cabin bag. Power banks and spare lithium batteries are not allowed in checked bags at all.

sources.title: Skelvane Air - Delayed, damaged or lost bags
sources.text:
If your checked bag does not arrive on the baggage belt, or arrives damaged, go to the Skelvane Air baggage desk in the arrivals hall before you leave the airport. Our staff will make a report and give you a reference number that you can use to track your bag online.

Delayed bags
Most delayed bags are found and delivered to you within 48 hours. We will deliver your bag to your home or hotel free of charge. While you wait, you can buy essential items such as toiletries and a change of clothes, and claim the cost back from us. Keep your receipts.

Damaged bags
If your bag is damaged, report it at the airport if you can, and in any case within 7 days of your flight. We will arrange a repair or, if your bag cannot be repaired, pay you its current value.

Lost bags
If your bag has not been found 21 days after your flight, we treat it as lost. You can then claim for the bag and its contents, up to the limit set by international air travel rules.

Making a claim
Claims can be made online using your reference number. Include your boarding pass, your bag tag and receipts for any items you bought or are claiming for.

gold.dropped_qualifier: For travel between 1 December 2026 and 15 January 2027

question: Can I cancel a Tarnwell booking and get my money back?
answer: You can cancel any Tarnwell reservation for a full refund.

sources.title: Tarnwell Stays - Paying for your stay
sources.text:
When you book a stay on Tarnwell, you see the full price before you confirm, including the nightly rate, any cleaning fee set by the host, taxes, and the Tarnwell service fee. There are no extra charges added at checkout.

Ways to pay
You can pay with a debit or credit card, with Tarnwell credit, or with a combination of the two. We do not accept cash or bank transfers, and you should never pay a host directly outside Tarnwell.

Paying in two parts
For stays booked more than 30 days before check-in, you can choose to pay half now and half later. The second payment is taken automatically from the same card 14 days before check-in, and we will email you three days before we take it.

Currency
Prices are shown in the currency you choose in your account settings. If your card is in a different currency, your bank may apply its own exchange rate or fees.

Receipts
Your receipt is available in the app under Trips as soon as your booking is confirmed. Business travellers can add a company name and tax number to the receipt before downloading it.

sources.title: Tarnwell Stays - Checking in and out
sources.text:
Each listing shows its check-in and check-out times, which are set by the host. Most hosts offer check-in from 3 p.m. and ask guests to check out by 11 a.m.

Getting the keys
Your host's check-in instructions appear in the Tarnwell app under Trips 48 hours before your stay begins. Many listings offer self check-in using a key box or smart lock, with a code that is shown only to you. For other listings, the host or a co-host will meet you to hand over the keys.

Arriving early or late
If you expect to arrive earlier or later than the listed check-in time, message your host through the app as soon as you can. Hosts are not required to offer early check-in, but many will store your luggage if they can.

Before you leave
Follow the host's checkout list, which usually asks you to load the dishwasher, take out the rubbish and lock up. Leave the keys where the host asked you to.

Problems during your stay
If something at the listing is not as described, such as a broken shower or no hot water, report it in the app with photos within 24 hours of finding it. We will work with the host to fix it.

sources.title: Tarnwell Stays - Cancelling a reservation
sources.text:
You can cancel a reservation in the Tarnwell app or on our website. Go to Trips, select the reservation, tap Cancel reservation and confirm. We will send you an email confirming the cancellation, and your host is told straight away.

During the first 24 hours after booking, you can cancel any Tarnwell reservation for a full refund. A full refund includes the nightly rate, the cleaning fee, taxes and the Tarnwell service fee.

How refunds are paid
Refunds go back to the payment method you used to book. If you paid by card, the refund usually appears on your statement within 5 to 10 business days, depending on your bank. If you paid with Tarnwell credit, the credit is returned to your account straight away. If you used both, each part is refunded to where it came from.

Other guests on the reservation
Only the person who made the booking can cancel it. Other guests you added to the reservation receive an email to let them know the trip has been cancelled, so you do not need to tell them yourself.

question: Does Talvery Air charge a fee to change my flight?
answer: You can change your flight once without a change fee.

sources.title: Talvery Air - Choosing your seat
sources.text:
When you book a Talvery Air flight, you can choose your seat straight away or leave it until later. If you have not chosen a seat by the time you check in, we will assign one to you free of charge, and we will try to seat people on the same booking together.

Seat prices
Standard seats in rows 10 to 30 cost $12 per flight. Seats in rows 3 to 9 are near the front of the cabin, so you can leave the aircraft sooner, and cost $18 per flight. Extra legroom seats in row 1 and the exit rows cost $35 per flight.

Exit rows
To sit in an exit row you must be at least 15 years old, able to lift 15 kg, and willing to help the crew in an emergency. You cannot sit in an exit row if you are travelling with an infant.

Changing your seat
You can change your seat in Manage Booking until check-in closes. If you move to a seat that costs more, you pay the difference. If you move to a cheaper seat, or give up a seat you paid for, the difference is not refunded.

Families
Children under 12 are always seated next to at least one adult on the same booking at no charge, even if nobody on the booking has paid for a seat.

sources.title: Talvery Air - Check-in and boarding
sources.text:
Online check-in opens 24 hours before departure and closes 60 minutes before departure. You can check in on our website or in the Talvery Air app, and keep your boarding pass on your phone or print it at home.

If you prefer to check in at the airport, our desks open three hours before departure and close 45 minutes before departure. You will need to check in at a desk if you need special assistance or are carrying sporting equipment or other items that must be declared.

Bag drop
If you have checked in online and have a bag to check, take it to the bag drop desk before it closes, 45 minutes before departure.

Boarding
Boarding usually starts 40 minutes before departure, and the gate closes 15 minutes before departure. We board by group number, which is printed on your boarding pass. Passengers who need extra time and families with children under 5 are invited to board first.

Identity documents
Bring a valid photo ID that matches the name on your booking. If you are flying abroad, you will need a passport that is valid for the whole of your trip, and any visa your destination requires.

sources.title: Talvery Air - Changing your flight
sources.text:
You can change the date or time of your Talvery Air flight online in Manage Booking, in the Talvery Air app, or by calling our reservations team. Changes made by phone follow the same rules as changes made online.

You can change your flight once without a change fee if you make the change at least 14 days before the original departure date. If your new flight costs more than your original flight, you pay the difference in fare and any extra taxes. If your new flight costs less, we return the difference to you as Talvery travel credit, which is valid for 12 months from the date it is issued.

Who travels on the new flight
Everyone on the same booking must move to the new flight together. If only some of the passengers on a booking want to change, call our reservations team, who can split the booking for you first.

Names on a booking
Tickets cannot be transferred to another person. If a passenger's name is misspelt on a booking, contact us before check-in opens and we will correct it free of charge.

After you change
We will email you a new itinerary as soon as the change is confirmed. Any seats or extra bags you paid for are moved to your new flight where the same options are available.

question: Do I pay interest on purchases with my Ostlemark card?
answer: Purchases on your Ostlemark card are not charged interest.

sources.title: Ostlemark Card - Earning and using points
sources.text:
Every purchase you make with your Ostlemark credit card earns points. You earn 1 point for every $1 you spend, and 2 points for every $1 spent on flights, hotels and car hire booked directly with the airline, hotel or rental company. Points are added to your account when the purchase is posted, which usually takes one to three business days.

Using your points
You can redeem points in the Ostlemark app once you have 1,000 points or more. Points can be turned into a statement credit at 1 cent per point, transferred to a partner airline loyalty programme, or used to buy gift cards from our partner shops.

Points that are not earned
Points are not earned on cash withdrawals, balance transfers, fees, or payments to gambling websites. If you return an item, the points you earned on it are removed from your account.

Keeping your points
Your points do not expire as long as your account is open. If you close your account, any points you have not redeemed are lost, so remember to use them first.

sources.title: Ostlemark Card - Statements and payment due dates
sources.text:
Your Ostlemark statement is produced on the same date each month. It lists every transaction posted since your last statement and shows your statement balance, your minimum payment and your payment due date. Your payment due date is 25 days after your statement date.

Purchases on your Ostlemark card are not charged interest if you pay your statement balance in full by the due date.

Ways to pay
You can pay from any US bank account in the Ostlemark app, set up an automatic payment, or mail a check. Automatic payments can be set to pay your statement balance, your minimum payment or a fixed amount each month, and they are taken on your due date. Payments made in the app before 8 p.m. Eastern time count as received that day.

Your minimum payment
Your minimum payment is $25 or 1% of your statement balance, whichever is higher. If your statement balance is less than $25, your minimum payment is the full statement balance.

Changing your statement date
You can ask to move your statement date once every 12 months from Settings > Statements. The change takes effect after your next statement, so one statement may cover a shorter or longer period than usual.

sources.title: Ostlemark Card - Authorised users
sources.text:
You can add up to four authorised users to your Ostlemark credit card account. Each authorised user gets their own card with their name on it, and their purchases appear on your statement. You are responsible for paying for everything they spend.

Who can be added

Points that are not earned

sources.title: Ostlemark Card - Statements and payment due dates
sources.text:
Your Ostlemark statement is produced on the same date each month. It lists every transaction posted since your last statement and shows your statement balance, your minimum payment and your payment due date. Your payment due date is 25 days after your statement date.

Ways to pay

Your minimum payment

Changing your statement date

question: What interest rate do Glenmarrow Savings Vaults pay?
answer: Savings Vaults earn 3.20% AER on balances up to $50,000.

sources.title: Glenmarrow Money - Setting up a Savings Vault
sources.text:
Savings Vaults let you put money aside inside your Glenmarrow account, separate from the money you spend day to day. You can have up to ten Vaults open at once and give each one a name, an emoji and an optional savings goal.

Creating a Vault
In the app, tap Vaults, then New Vault. Choose a name, set a goal amount and a target date if you want one, and decide how much to move in to start. You can create a Vault with a zero balance and add money later.

Moving money in and out
You can move money between your main balance and any Vault instantly, as often as you like, at no cost. Money in a Vault cannot be spent with your card until you move it back to your main balance.

Round-ups
Turn on Round-ups and every card purchase is rounded up to the nearest dollar, with the spare change moved into the Vault of your choice. For example, a $3.40 coffee moves 60 cents into your Vault.

Closing a Vault
When you close a Vault, the money in it goes straight back to your main balance. You can reopen a closed Vault within 30 days from the Vaults screen.

sources.title: Glenmarrow Money - Sending money abroad
sources.text:
You can send money from your Glenmarrow account to bank accounts in more than 40 countries. Open Payments, choose Send abroad, and enter your recipient's name, bank details and the amount you want to send, either in dollars or in their currency.

Fees and exchange rates
Before you confirm a transfer, the app shows the exchange rate, our fee and exactly how much your recipient will receive. Our fee is 0.6% of the amount you send, with a minimum of $2. There are no hidden charges added to the exchange rate, but your recipient's bank may charge its own fee for receiving the money.

How long it takes
Most transfers arrive within one business day. Transfers to some countries, or transfers that need extra security checks, can take up to five business days. We will tell you the expected arrival date before you confirm.

Limits
You can send up to $10,000 abroad in a single transfer and up to $25,000 in any 30-day period.

Cancelling a transfer
You can cancel a transfer in the app as long as its status still shows Scheduled. Once a transfer shows Sent, it cannot be cancelled.

sources.title: Glenmarrow Money - Premium plan
sources.text:
Glenmarrow Premium is a monthly subscription plan for your Glenmarrow account. It costs $8 per month, taken from your main balance on the same day each month. You can cancel at any time in the app, and Premium stays active until the end of the month you have already paid for.

What Premium includes
- A daily ATM withdrawal limit of $1,500
- Free replacement cards, sent by express delivery
- Priority support through in-app chat, seven days a week
- Travel insurance for trips of up to 31 days

Savings Vaults on Premium
On the Premium plan, Savings Vaults earn 3.20% AER on balances up to $50,000. Interest is calculated on your end-of-day balance and paid into each Vault on the first business day of the following month. The rate is variable, and we will give you at least 30 days' notice before we lower it.

Upgrading
You can upgrade from Account > Plan in the app. Premium starts straight away, and your first monthly fee is taken on the day you upgrade.

Travel insurance
Travel insurance covers you and your partner for medical emergencies, cancelled trips and lost luggage. Details of what is covered, and how to make a claim, are in the policy document in the app.

question: How long does Hollicott keep the voice recordings from my speaker?
answer: Voice recordings are deleted automatically 30 days after they are made.

sources.title: Hollicott Home - Setting up your speaker
sources.text:
To set up a Hollicott speaker you need the Hollicott app on a phone or tablet, a Hollicott account, and a Wi-Fi network that you know the password for.

1. Plug the speaker in. The light ring glows white while it starts up, and then pulses orange when it is ready to be set up.
2. Open the Hollicott app, tap Add device, and choose Speaker. The app will find speakers nearby that are ready to set up.
3. Choose the room the speaker is in, such as Kitchen or Bedroom. This helps when you have more than one speaker.
4. Select your Wi-Fi network and enter the password. The speaker connects and checks for updates, which can take a few minutes.
5. When the light ring turns off, the speaker is ready. Try asking it about the weather to check that everything works.

If setup does not work
Make sure your phone is connected to the same Wi-Fi network you are setting the speaker up on, and that the speaker is within range of your router. If the light ring flashes red, hold the action button for 15 seconds to reset the speaker, then start again.

Adding other people
Anyone in your household can use the speaker. To let them control it from their own phone, invite them from Home > Members in the app.

sources.title: Hollicott Home - Voice recordings and your privacy
sources.text:
A Hollicott speaker starts recording when it hears the wake word, Hey Hollicott, and the light ring turns blue while it is recording. The recording is sent to Hollicott so that we can work out what you asked for and respond.

Voice profiles
Each person in your household can create a voice profile, so that the speaker can tell who is talking and give personal answers, such as reading out their own calendar. A parent or guardian can set up a child profile for a child under 13 from the Family section of the Hollicott app.

For child profiles, voice recordings are deleted automatically 30 days after they are made. The parent or guardian who set up a child profile can listen to that child's recordings in the app and can delete any of them sooner.

Reviewing your recordings
Open the Hollicott app and go to Privacy > Voice history to see a list of requests made on your speakers. You can play back a request, read its transcript and delete it. You can also say Hey Hollicott, delete what I just said, to remove your most recent request.

Muting the microphone
Press the microphone button on top of the speaker to turn the microphone off. The light ring turns red, and the speaker will not respond to the wake word until you press the button again.

Who can hear recordings
Recordings are not shared with advertisers. A small number of recordings may be reviewed by trained Hollicott staff to improve speech recognition if you have turned on Help improve Hollicott in Privacy settings.

sources.title: Hollicott Home - Linking music services
sources.text:
You can play music on your Hollicott speaker from the music services you already use. Open the Hollicott app, go to Settings > Music, tap Link a service, and sign in to your account with that service. Once a service is linked, you can ask for songs, albums, artists, playlists and radio stations by name.

Choosing a default service
If you have linked more than one service, choose a default so the speaker knows where to play from when you do not say. You can still ask for a different service by naming it at the end of your request.

Playing on more than one speaker
Group speakers in the app under Home > Speaker groups, then ask for music on the group's name, such as Downstairs, to play the same music in several rooms at once.

Each household member's own account
If each person in your household has a voice profile, the speaker plays from the music account linked to whoever is speaking. Otherwise it uses the account linked by the person who set up the speaker.

Unlinking a service
To remove a service, go to Settings > Music, choose the service and tap Unlink. Any playlists you made stay in your account with the music service.

gold.target_claim: Hollicott automatically deletes all voice recordings 30 days after they are made, not only those from child profiles.

gold_spans.quote: For child profiles, voice recordings are deleted automatically 30 days after they are made.

gold.dropped_qualifier: For child profiles

construction.note: Deleted only the 'For child profiles' scope (and capitalised 'Voice'); S2 gives 30-day automatic deletion for child profiles and no passage says how long other recordings are kept, so the claim for all recordings is unsupported.
