question: Is Ondrel deleting my old alarm history?
answer: All alarm events recorded between 1 January 2023 and 31 May 2024 will be permanently deleted on 1 February 2027.

sources.title: How long camera clips are kept
sources.text:
Clips from Wardline cameras are saved to the cloud when motion is detected or an alarm goes off. How long they are kept depends on your plan.

Wardline Essentials keeps clips for 7 days. Wardline Plus keeps clips for 30 days, and Wardline Pro Monitoring keeps them for 60 days. Clips recorded during an alarm are kept for 90 days on every plan, so that you have time to share them with your insurer or the police.

When you change plan, the new retention period applies to clips recorded after the change. Clips you already have keep the retention period they were saved with.

To keep a clip for longer, open it in the History tab and tap Download. Downloaded clips are saved to your phone and are not deleted when the cloud copy expires. Deleting a clip in the app removes the cloud copy only; anything you have downloaded stays on your device.

sources.title: Changes to alarm history in the Ondrel app
sources.text:
We are moving alarm history to a new storage system so that the History tab loads faster and can be searched.

All alarm events recorded between 1 January 2023 and 31 May 2024 will be permanently deleted on 1 December 2026. Once they are deleted, Ondrel support cannot recover them.

If you want to keep a copy of these events, download them before the deletion date. In the app, go to Settings > Account > Download my data and choose Alarm history. The file arrives by email as a CSV within 24 hours. Each download covers up to 12 months of events, so you may need to request more than one.

This change affects alarm events only: arming and disarming, sensor triggers, panic button presses and siren activations. Camera clips are stored separately and follow the retention period of your plan.

Only the account owner can request a download. Shared users can still view alarm history in the app but cannot export it.

sources.title: Arming your system on a schedule
sources.text:
An arming schedule sets your Wardline system to Home or Away automatically at the times you choose, so you do not have to remember to arm it every night.

To create one, go to Settings > Security > Arming schedule and tap Add. Choose the mode, the time and the days of the week. You can add up to 6 schedules per system. Schedules follow the time zone set for your home, not the time zone of your phone.

Five minutes before a scheduled arming, everyone on the account who has notifications turned on receives a reminder. If a door or window is open at that time, the system arms anyway and leaves that sensor out until it is closed, and the app tells you which sensor was skipped.

Schedules can only arm the system. Disarming always needs a code, the app or a key fob, so a schedule will never disarm Wardline for you.

construction.note: Deletion date changed from 1 December 2026 to 1 February 2027; S2 states the deletion happens on 1 December 2026.

question: What is Ellingrove's hotel cap for a business trip to Manchester?
answer: The nightly accommodation cap for an Ellingrove business trip to Manchester is GBP 210.

sources.title: Ellingrove Insurance - Travel Policy: Getting There
sources.text:
Standard class rail is the default for business journeys within Great Britain. First class may be booked only when the journey is longer than three hours and you will be working on the train, or when it is cheaper than standard class at the time of booking.

Domestic flights are permitted only where the equivalent rail journey would take more than five hours, for example between London and Edinburgh or Glasgow, or for travel to and from Belfast. Economy fares with one checked bag are the default.

Taxis may be used when public transport is not reasonably available, when you are carrying heavy equipment, or when travelling alone between 10 pm and 6 am. Keep the receipt and note the reason in your claim.

If you drive your own car on business, the mileage rate is 45 pence per mile for the first 10,000 business miles in the tax year and 25 pence per mile after that. Ellingrove does not reimburse fuel separately when you claim mileage.

Car hire must be booked through the travel tool. Choose the smallest car that is suitable for the journey and the number of passengers, and return it with a full tank.

sources.title: Ellingrove Insurance - Travel Policy: Accommodation
sources.text:
Ellingrove Insurance employees who need to stay overnight for business should book hotels through the corporate travel tool, which shows properties that offer our negotiated rates. Book the most economical option that is reasonably close to where you need to be.

Nightly accommodation caps. The following caps apply per night for a standard room, including taxes but excluding breakfast:
- London: GBP 210
- Manchester: GBP 140
- Edinburgh and Glasgow: GBP 150
- Belfast: GBP 125
- All other UK locations: GBP 110

If no suitable room is available within the cap, for example during a major event, your travel approver can authorise a higher rate before you book. Rooms booked above the cap without prior approval will be reimbursed only up to the cap.

Breakfast may be claimed separately up to GBP 15 per morning where it is not included in the room rate. Stays with friends or family are not reimbursed, but you may claim up to GBP 25 per stay for a thank-you gift for your hosts.

For stays of more than five consecutive nights in one location, speak to the travel team about serviced apartments, which are often cheaper.

gold.target_claim: The nightly accommodation cap for a business trip to Manchester is GBP 210.

gold_spans.quote: London: GBP 210
Manchester: GBP 140

construction.note: GBP 210 is the London cap stated about Manchester; S2 gives Manchester GBP 140.

question: How much paid bereavement leave do Ravelstone colleagues get when a grandparent dies?
answer: Ravelstone colleagues can take up to 10 days of paid bereavement leave following the death of a grandparent.

sources.title: Ravelstone Pharmacy Group - Bereavement and Compassionate Leave
sources.text:
We know that losing someone close is one of the hardest things anyone goes through. This policy sets out the paid time off available to Ravelstone colleagues when someone close to them dies.

Paid bereavement leave. Colleagues can take up to 10 days of paid bereavement leave following the death of a spouse, civil partner, partner or child, including a stillbirth after 24 weeks of pregnancy. Colleagues can take up to 5 days of paid bereavement leave following the death of a parent, step-parent, sibling or grandparent. For the death of another relative or a close friend, colleagues can take 1 day of paid leave to attend the funeral.

The days do not have to be taken together, and they can be taken at any point within 6 months of the death, for example to attend a funeral abroad or deal with the person's estate.

Pharmacists and pharmacy technicians should let their store manager know as early as possible so that locum cover can be arranged; colleagues in the support office should tell their line manager.

Further time off. If you need more time, you can take annual leave or unpaid leave, or your manager may agree a phased return. Colleagues can also use the Employee Assistance Programme for free, confidential bereavement counselling at any time.

sources.title: Ravelstone Pharmacy Group - Time Off for Dependants
sources.text:
Colleagues are entitled to reasonable time off to deal with an unexpected situation involving a dependant, such as a child falling ill, a breakdown in childcare arrangements, or an elderly relative needing urgent help. A dependant is your spouse or partner, your child, a parent, or anyone who lives with you or relies on you for care.

The first 2 days of time off for dependants in any calendar year are paid at your normal rate. Further time off is unpaid, although you may choose to use annual leave instead.

Time off for dependants is meant for dealing with the immediate situation and arranging longer-term care, not for providing that care over a long period. In most cases one or two days will be enough. If you need more time, talk to your manager about annual leave, unpaid leave or a temporary change to your working pattern.

In stores, please call your store manager before the start of your shift, or as soon as you reasonably can. Support office colleagues should contact their line manager by phone or message. On your return, record the absence in the HR system under 'Dependant leave'.

question: When does Ottervane's office attendance requirement increase to three days a week?
answer: Ottervane’s minimum office attendance for hybrid employees increases from two to three days per week from 5 October 2026.

sources.title: Ottervane Insurance - Home-Working Equipment
sources.text:
Every Ottervane employee who works from home for part or all of the week can order a standard home-working kit through the IT self-service portal. The kit includes a monitor, a docking station, a keyboard and mouse, and a headset approved for use with our telephony system.

If you need an ergonomic chair, a sit-stand desk or other specialist equipment, complete a display screen equipment self-assessment first. Where the assessment shows a need, Occupational Health will arrange the equipment and it will be delivered to your home.

Equipment provided by Ottervane remains company property. It must be returned through the courier collection service when you leave or if you no longer work from home, and it is covered by Ottervane's insurance while it is at your home address.

You are responsible for providing a suitable home internet connection. Ottervane does not reimburse broadband or energy costs, but employees who work from home regularly may be able to claim tax relief directly from the tax authority.

Faulty equipment should be reported to the IT service desk, which will normally send a replacement within three working days.

sources.title: Ottervane Insurance - Hybrid Working: Changes to Office Attendance
sources.text:
Over the past year, many teams have told us that they get the most value from the office when they are there together. After consultation with employee representatives, we are changing our hybrid working guidance.

From 5 January 2027, the minimum office attendance for hybrid employees will increase from two to three days per week. Until then, the current minimum of two days per week continues to apply. Each team will agree its anchor days with its leadership team before the end of November 2026, so that colleagues can plan childcare and travel.

The change does not affect employees with a contractual home-working arrangement, employees with an agreed workplace adjustment, or field-based claims handlers, whose working patterns are set out in their contracts.

To support the change, we are adding bookable desks at our Exeter and Leicester offices, and the staff restaurant in Leicester will open on Fridays from January.

If you think the change will cause you particular difficulty, please talk to your manager or the People team. Requests for flexible working continue to be considered under our flexible working policy.

gold.target_claim: The minimum office attendance for hybrid employees increases from two to three days per week from 5 October 2026.

gold_spans.quote: From 5 January 2027, the minimum office attendance for hybrid employees will increase from two to three days per week.

construction.note: The two-to-three-day change is correct but S2 dates it 5 January 2027 and says two days applies until then.

question: When does Glenvarra's employer pension contribution go up to 7%?
answer: Glenvarra’s employer pension contribution rises to 7% for members who contribute at least 4% from the April 2026 payroll.

sources.title: Glenvarra Utilities - Pension Plan Changes: What You Need to Know
sources.text:
Following this year's pay and benefits negotiations with the recognised unions, Glenvarra Utilities has agreed a phased increase in the employer contribution to the Glenvarra Defined Contribution Pension Plan.

At present, Glenvarra contributes 6% of pensionable salary when you contribute at least 4%. From the April 2027 payroll, the employer contribution will rise to 7% for members who contribute at least 4%. A further rise to 8% is planned from the April 2028 payroll, subject to the outcome of the 2027 pay review.

You do not need to change your own contribution to receive the higher employer contribution. However, if you currently contribute less than 4%, you will continue to receive the minimum employer contribution of 3% until you increase your own rate.

Salary sacrifice. Most members pay their contributions through salary sacrifice, which reduces the National Insurance they pay. If you have opted out of salary sacrifice, you can opt back in at any time through the benefits portal.

If you have questions about how the changes affect you, book a call with the pension helpline. The helpline is run by the plan administrator and is free for all members.

sources.title: Glenvarra Utilities - Life Assurance and Income Protection
sources.text:
Life assurance. All permanent employees are covered by Glenvarra's group life assurance scheme from their first day of service. If you die while employed by Glenvarra, the scheme pays a tax-free lump sum of four times your annual basic salary to the people you have chosen. Please keep your expression of wish form up to date in the benefits portal, especially after a change such as marriage, separation or the birth of a child.

Income protection. If you cannot work because of long-term illness or injury, the income protection scheme pays 60% of your basic salary after a waiting period of 26 weeks. Payments continue until you return to work, reach state pension age or leave Glenvarra, and are reduced by any state incapacity benefit you receive. While you are receiving income protection payments, Glenvarra continues to pay its pension contributions at the current rate.

Rehabilitation support. The insurer provides a case manager who can arrange physiotherapy, counselling or a phased return-to-work plan. You can be referred by Occupational Health at any point during an absence, not only once the waiting period has ended.

gold.target_claim: Glenvarra's employer pension contribution rises to 7% for members who contribute at least 4% from the April 2026 payroll.

gold_spans.quote: From the April 2027 payroll, the employer contribution will rise to 7% for members who contribute at least 4%.

construction.note: The 7% rise is correct but S1 dates it to the April 2027 payroll, not April 2026.

question: Does Tolvane Engineering's dental cover pay for children's orthodontic treatment?
answer: Tolvane Engineering's dental cover reimburses 50% of orthodontic treatment for dependent children under 18.

sources.title: Bramblecrest Dental Network - Guide to Employer Group Schedules
sources.text:
Bramblecrest Dental Network administers dental cover for employer groups through more than 1,800 participating practices. Each employer chooses one of two benefit schedules for its whole group, and members should check their employer's plan documents to see which schedule applies to them.

Essential schedule. Covers two check-ups and two hygienist appointments a year, plus X-rays, fillings and extractions at 80% of the treatment cost, up to an annual maximum of GBP 1,000 per member. Orthodontic treatment is not covered under the Essential schedule.

Plus schedule. Covers everything in the Essential schedule at 90% of the treatment cost, up to an annual maximum of GBP 1,750 per member, and adds crowns, bridges and root canal treatment. Orthodontic treatment for dependent children under 18 is reimbursed at 50%, up to a lifetime maximum of GBP 2,000 per child.

Emergency treatment. Under both schedules, members can claim up to GBP 250 a year for emergency dental treatment received while travelling abroad.

Claims. Most participating practices submit claims to us directly. If you pay the practice yourself, submit your itemised receipt through the Bramblecrest member app within 90 days of treatment.

sources.title: Tolvane Engineering - Benefits Summary 2026
sources.text:
This summary gives an overview of the core benefits available to Tolvane Engineering employees in 2026. Full details are in the plan documents on the benefits portal.

Medical. Employees can choose between the Tolvane Core plan and the Tolvane Enhanced plan. Both plans cover hospital treatment, specialist consultations and diagnostic tests. The Enhanced plan adds outpatient physiotherapy, mental health therapy without a GP referral and a lower annual excess. Tolvane pays the full premium for the Core plan; employees who choose the Enhanced plan pay the difference through payroll.

Dental. Members of either medical plan receive dental cover administered by Bramblecrest Dental Network. Dental cover can be extended to your partner and children for a monthly contribution taken from your salary.

Vision. Employees receive an eye test every two years and a contribution of up to GBP 120 toward glasses or contact lenses.

Life assurance. Tolvane provides life cover of three times basic salary for all permanent employees.

Changes. You can switch between the Core and Enhanced plans each year during the December enrolment window, or after a qualifying life event such as marriage or the birth of a child.

gold_spans.quote: Members of either medical plan receive dental cover administered by Bramblecrest Dental Network.
Orthodontic treatment for dependent children under 18 is reimbursed at 50%, up to a lifetime maximum of GBP 2,000 per child.

question: What is the maximum value of a bike under Nimbrook's cycle-to-work scheme?
answer: Nimbrook’s cycle-to-work scheme covers bikes and equipment up to a total value of GBP 1,000.

sources.title: Nimbrook Studios - Benefits Booklet 2024: Cycle to Work
sources.text:
Last reviewed: 9 September 2024.

Nimbrook Studios takes part in a cycle-to-work salary sacrifice scheme. You choose a bike and safety equipment from a participating retailer, Nimbrook buys it, and you hire it from us through monthly deductions from your gross salary over 12 months.

The cycle-to-work scheme covers bikes and equipment up to a total value of GBP 1,000. Electric bikes are not included in the scheme.

Because the deductions are taken before tax and National Insurance, the overall cost to you is usually between 25% and 40% lower than buying the bike yourself, depending on your tax band.

At the end of the hire period, you can take ownership of the bike for a small final payment set by the scheme provider.

You can apply once in any 24-month period. Applications open on the first working day of each month and close when that month's budget has been used. If you leave Nimbrook before the end of the hire period, the outstanding deductions will be taken from your final salary.

sources.title: Nimbrook Studios - People Updates: Changes to the Cycle-to-Work Scheme
sources.text:
Updated 3 March 2026. We are making two changes to the cycle-to-work scheme, which take effect for all applications submitted from 1 April 2026.

First, the cycle-to-work limit has been raised to GBP 2,500 for bikes and equipment. This replaces the GBP 1,000 limit set out in the 2024 Benefits Booklet. Second, electric bikes are now included in the scheme, as long as they meet the legal definition of an electrically assisted pedal cycle.

The hire period remains 12 months, and you can still apply only once in any 24-month period. Applications submitted before 1 April 2026 will be processed under the previous rules.

If you have an application in progress and would like to withdraw it and reapply under the new limit, contact the People team before your order is placed with the retailer.

The Benefits Booklet will be reissued later this year. Until then, please treat this update as the current policy for the cycle-to-work scheme.

question: Can Sorrelwick colleagues claim parking and tolls on business journeys?
answer: Parking charges and road tolls paid during a business journey can be claimed in addition to mileage, as long as a receipt is attached [S1].

sources.title: Sorrelwick Retail Group - Company Cards and Claim Approval
sources.text:
Colleagues who travel or buy goods for the business regularly may be issued a Sorrelwick company card. The card must only be used for business expenses allowed under this policy. Cash withdrawals are blocked, and any personal spending on the card must be repaid within 14 days.

Every transaction on a company card must be matched to a receipt and coded in the Expenses app by the end of the following month. If a receipt is lost, complete a missing receipt declaration; more than three declarations in any 12-month period will be reviewed by Finance.

Expense claims are approved by your line manager. Managers should check that each item has a business purpose, that the correct expense category has been used and that the amount is within the limits in this policy. Claims over GBP 500 also need approval from the budget holder.

Approved claims for out-of-pocket expenses are paid with the next monthly salary, provided they are approved by the 20th of the month. Claims approved after that date are paid the following month.

Misuse of a company card or the submission of a false claim is treated as gross misconduct under the disciplinary policy.

sources.title: Sorrelwick Retail Group - Expenses Policy: Overnight Stays and Meals
sources.text:
Colleagues who need to stay away from home overnight on business should book accommodation through the Sorrelwick travel desk, which has negotiated rates with hotels near our stores and distribution centres. If the travel desk cannot find a room within the nightly limit, it may approve a higher rate in advance.

The nightly limits for a room only are GBP 140 in London and GBP 95 elsewhere in the UK. Breakfast may be added if it is not included in the room rate.

When you are away overnight, you can claim the actual cost of an evening meal up to GBP 30, including one soft drink. Lunch can be claimed up to GBP 10 when a business journey takes you more than five miles from your usual place of work between 12:00 and 14:00. Alcohol is not reimbursed.

Personal items such as newspapers, toiletries, in-room films and laundry for stays of fewer than four nights are not reimbursable.

All claims for accommodation and meals must be submitted through the Expenses app with itemised receipts. Card payment slips on their own are not accepted as receipts.

sources.title: Sorrelwick Retail Group - Expenses Policy: Mileage and Vehicle Costs
sources.text:
This section explains how Sorrelwick Retail Group reimburses colleagues who use their own vehicle for business journeys, such as travelling between stores, visiting suppliers or attending training at the Support Centre. Ordinary commuting between home and your usual place of work is not a business journey and cannot be claimed.

Mileage rates. Colleagues who use their own car for business journeys will be reimbursed at 52 pence per mile from 1 April 2026, provided the journey is recorded in the mileage log within 30 days of travel. Journeys recorded after that deadline are not reimbursed. Journeys made before 1 April 2026 are reimbursed at the previous rate of 45 pence per mile. Business journeys by motorcycle are reimbursed at 24 pence per mile and by bicycle at 20 pence per mile.

Passengers. If you carry a colleague who is also travelling on business, you can add 5 pence per mile for each passenger.

Parking and tolls. Parking charges and road tolls paid during a business journey can be claimed in addition to mileage, as long as a receipt is attached. Penalty charges, including parking fines and speeding fines, are never reimbursed.

Insurance. Before using your own vehicle for work, make sure your motor insurance covers business use. Sorrelwick does not reimburse the extra cost of business-use cover, and you may be asked to show your certificate of insurance at any time.

question: How much does Saltmarrow pay each month toward family coverage on the Silverline plan?
answer: Saltmarrow pays $412 a month toward family coverage on the Silverline medical plan.

sources.title: Saltmarrow Health - Dental and Vision Plans
sources.text:
Dental coverage is provided through a preventive-focused plan. Cleanings, exams and X-rays are covered in full; basic services such as fillings are covered at 80% after a $50 annual deductible; major services such as crowns are covered at 50%. The annual benefit maximum is $1,500 per covered person.

Monthly employee contributions for dental coverage are $9 for employee only, $18 for employee plus one, and $31 for family coverage. Saltmarrow pays the remainder of the dental premium.

Vision coverage includes an annual eye exam with a $10 copay and an allowance of $150 every 12 months toward frames or contact lenses. The vision plan is fully paid by Saltmarrow for employees and their enrolled dependents.

Dental and vision are separate from medical, so you can enroll in them even if you waive medical coverage. Changes to dental and vision elections follow the same open enrollment and life event rules as medical.

sources.title: Saltmarrow Health - Medical Plan Costs
sources.text:
Saltmarrow Health offers two medical plans to employees: the Silverline plan and the Goldline plan. Both plans use the same network of hospitals and clinics; the Goldline plan has lower deductibles and copays.

How costs are shared. For the Silverline plan, Saltmarrow pays 80% of the monthly premium for employee-only coverage and 65% of the monthly premium for family coverage. For the Goldline plan, Saltmarrow pays 70% of the monthly premium for employee-only coverage and 55% for family coverage. Your share is deducted from your pay before tax.

Premium amounts are set each year by the insurer and are shown in the enrollment portal when open enrollment begins. Because premiums can change from year to year, your payroll deduction may change on 1 January even if you keep the same plan and coverage level.

Opting out. If you have medical coverage through a spouse or partner, you can waive Saltmarrow coverage and receive an opt-out credit of $100 per month, paid through payroll. Proof of other coverage is required each year.

question: How much paid parental leave do secondary caregivers get at Brennholt Logistics?
answer: Secondary caregivers who have completed 26 weeks of continuous service by the expected date of birth or placement receive 18 weeks of parental leave at full base pay.

sources.title: Brennholt Logistics Employee Handbook - 6.1 Annual Leave
sources.text:
All permanent employees at Brennholt Logistics receive 25 days of paid annual leave per leave year, plus the eight public holidays observed in England and Wales. The leave year runs from 1 January to 31 December. Employees who join or leave part-way through the year receive a pro-rata entitlement, rounded up to the nearest half day.

Part-time employees receive annual leave in proportion to their contracted hours. For example, an employee contracted for three days a week receives 15 days of annual leave plus a pro-rata share of public holidays.

After five years of continuous service, the entitlement rises to 27 days. After ten years it rises to 29 days. The increase applies from the start of the leave year following the service anniversary.

Leave requests should be submitted through the HR portal at least two weeks in advance for absences of three days or more. Managers may decline a request during the November and December peak period if minimum staffing levels in a depot would not be met.

Up to five days of unused annual leave can be carried into the first three months of the following leave year. Carried-over days that are not taken by 31 March are lost, unless the employee could not take them because of sickness or family leave.

sources.title: Brennholt Logistics Employee Handbook - 6.2 Parental Leave
sources.text:
Brennholt Logistics supports employees who are welcoming a child through birth, adoption or surrogacy. This section sets out company parental pay for permanent employees of any gender.

Primary caregivers who have completed 26 weeks of continuous service by the expected date of birth or placement receive 18 weeks of parental leave at full base pay. Secondary caregivers who meet the same service condition receive 6 weeks of parental leave at full base pay. Employees who have not reached 26 weeks of service are still entitled to unpaid parental leave and to any statutory payments, but not to the enhanced company pay described in this section.

Paid parental leave may be taken in one continuous block or in up to three separate blocks of at least two weeks each. All paid parental leave must be taken within 52 weeks of the birth or placement, and any weeks not used by then are lost.

Employees should tell their line manager and the People team about their plans at least eight weeks before the intended start date, using the parental leave form in the HR portal.

Where both parents work for Brennholt, one parent is designated the primary caregiver and the other the secondary caregiver. The two entitlements cannot be combined so that one parent takes both.

During paid parental leave, pension contributions, life assurance and private medical cover continue as if the employee were at work, and annual leave continues to accrue.

sources.title: Brennholt Logistics Employee Handbook - 6.3 Time Off for Appointments
sources.text:
Employees who are pregnant are entitled to paid time off to attend antenatal appointments advised by a midwife, doctor or registered nurse, including parenting classes where these have been recommended. Brennholt does not limit the number of antenatal appointments, but asks employees to book them at the start or end of a shift where this is practical.

The partner of a pregnant employee, or an intended parent in a surrogacy arrangement, may take paid time off to attend up to two antenatal appointments of up to six and a half hours each.

Employees who are adopting may take paid time off to attend up to five adoption meetings before the child is placed with them. Where two people are adopting jointly, the second adopter may attend up to two of these meetings with pay.

Employees undergoing fertility treatment may take up to five days of paid leave in any rolling 12-month period for appointments and procedures. Their partner may take up to two days of paid leave in the same period to attend appointments with them.

Please record every appointment in the HR portal under 'Medical and family appointments' so that the time is paid correctly. Managers may ask to see an appointment card or letter for any appointment after the first.

gold_spans.quote: Primary caregivers who have completed 26 weeks of continuous service by the expected date of birth or placement receive 18 weeks of parental leave at full base pay.
Secondary caregivers who meet the same service condition receive 6 weeks of parental leave at full base pay.

The leave year runs from 1 January to 31 December. Employees who join or leave part-way through the year receive a pro-rata entitlement, rounded up to the nearest half day.

Part-time employees receive annual leave in proportion to their contracted hours. For example, an employee contracted for three days a week receives 15 days of annual leave plus a pro-rata share of public holidays.

After five years of continuous service, the entitlement rises to 27 days. After ten years it rises to 29 days. The increase applies from the start of the leave year following the service anniversary.

Leave requests should be submitted through the HR portal at least two weeks in advance for absences of three days or more. Managers may decline a request during the November and December peak period if minimum staffing levels in a depot would not be met.

Up to five days of unused annual leave can be carried into the first three months of the following leave year. Carried-over days that are not taken by 31 March are lost, unless the employee could not take them because of sickness or family leave.

sources.title: Brennholt Logistics Employee Handbook - 6.2 Parental Leave
sources.text:
Brennholt Logistics supports employees who are welcoming a child through birth, adoption or surrogacy. This section sets out company parental pay for permanent employees of any gender.

Primary caregivers who have completed 26 weeks of continuous service by the expected date of birth or placement receive 18 weeks of parental leave at full base pay. Secondary caregivers who meet the same service condition receive 6 weeks of parental leave at full base pay. Employees who have not reached 26 weeks of service are still entitled to unpaid parental leave and to any statutory payments, but not to the enhanced company pay described in this section.

Paid parental leave may be taken in one continuous block or in up to three separate blocks of at least two weeks each. All paid parental leave must be taken within 52 weeks of the birth or placement, and any weeks not used by then are lost.

Employees should tell their line manager and the People team about their plans at least eight weeks before the intended start date, using the parental leave form in the HR portal.

Where both parents work for Brennholt, one parent is designated the primary caregiver and the other the secondary caregiver. The two entitlements cannot be combined so that one parent takes both.

During paid parental leave, pension contributions, life assurance and private medical cover continue as if the employee were at work, and annual leave continues to accrue.

sources.title: Brennholt Logistics Employee Handbook - 6.3 Time Off for Appointments
sources.text:
Employees who are pregnant are entitled to paid time off to attend antenatal appointments advised by a midwife, doctor or registered nurse, including parenting classes where these have been recommended. Brennholt does not limit the number of antenatal appointments, but asks employees to book them at the start or end of a shift where this is practical.

The partner of a pregnant employee, or an intended parent in a surrogacy arrangement, may take paid time off to attend up to two antenatal appointments of up to six and a half hours each.

Employees who are adopting may take paid time off to attend up to five adoption meetings before the child is placed with them. Where two people are adopting jointly, the second adopter may attend up to two of these meetings with pay.

Employees undergoing fertility treatment may take up to five days of paid leave in any rolling 12-month period for appointments and procedures. Their partner may take up to two days of paid leave in the same period to attend appointments with them.

Please record every appointment in the HR portal under 'Medical and family appointments' so that the time is paid correctly. Managers may ask to see an appointment card or letter for any appointment after the first.

question: What is the annual learning budget for people managers at Halcyra Biotech?
answer: In the Research and Development division, people managers have an annual learning budget of EUR 1,500.

sources.title: Halcyra Biotech - Learning and Development Budgets
sources.text:
Halcyra Biotech wants every employee to keep learning. Each division receives an annual learning and development budget, which can be used for courses, conferences, professional certifications, books and online learning subscriptions that relate to the employee's current role or agreed development plan.

Individual budgets in Research and Development. In the Research and Development division, individual contributors have an annual learning budget of EUR 1,500 and people managers have an annual learning budget of EUR 2,100. The higher amount for managers is intended to cover leadership training in addition to scientific development.

Other divisions. Budgets for Manufacturing, Quality, Commercial and Corporate Functions are set each January by the division head and published on that division's intranet page. They are not individual allowances, so employees should agree any spending with their manager before booking.

Budgets run with the calendar year. Unused budget does not carry over to the following year and cannot be transferred to a colleague.

Approval and payment. Requests up to EUR 500 can be approved by your manager. Requests above EUR 500, and any request involving travel outside the EU, also need approval from the division's learning partner. Wherever possible, the Learning team pays the provider directly so that you do not have to claim the cost back.

If an employee leaves Halcyra within 12 months of completing a course that cost more than EUR 2,000, they may be asked to repay part of the cost, as set out in the training agreement signed before booking.

sources.title: Halcyra Biotech - Tuition Support for Degree Programmes
sources.text:
Tuition support is separate from the divisional learning and development budgets. It helps employees who want to complete a longer qualification, such as a part-time bachelor's or master's degree, a doctorate, or a chartered professional qualification that takes more than a year to complete.

Employees with at least 12 months of service and a current performance rating of 'meets expectations' or above can apply. Halcyra will cover up to 75% of tuition fees, to a maximum of EUR 6,000 per academic year, for a qualification that is relevant to the employee's career at Halcyra. Fees for resits, late registration, accommodation and travel are not covered.

Applications are reviewed twice a year, in March and September, by a panel that includes a representative from People and a senior leader from the applicant's division. The panel considers business relevance, the employee's development plan and the funding available.

Employees who receive tuition support sign an agreement that requires them to repay part of the fees if they leave Halcyra within two years of completing the qualification, or if they withdraw from the programme without good reason.

Tuition support is paid directly to the institution at the start of each academic year.

sources.title: Halcyra Biotech - Conference Attendance and Presenting
sources.text:
Attending scientific conferences is an important part of how Halcyra researchers share and learn. This page explains how attendance is organised. The cost of attending is normally paid from the relevant learning and development budget, unless you are presenting.

If you have had an abstract, poster or talk accepted, the Scientific Communications team will pay your registration fee, travel and accommodation from the central communications budget, so the trip does not reduce your learning budget. Send the acceptance letter to Scientific Communications at least six weeks before the event.

Before presenting any Halcyra data externally, you must get clearance from the Publication Review Board. The board meets every two weeks and needs the final slides or poster at least ten working days before the event.

To avoid too many colleagues attending the same event, no more than four employees from one department may attend a single conference unless a director agrees otherwise. Attendees are expected to share a short summary of what they learned with their team within a month of returning.

Travel to conferences is booked through the travel portal and follows the standard business travel policy.

Other divisions. Budgets for Manufacturing, Quality, Commercial and Corporate Functions are set each January by the division head and published on that division's intranet page. They are not individual allowances, so employees should agree any spending with their manager before booking.

Budgets run with the calendar year. Unused budget does not carry over to the following year and cannot be transferred to a colleague.

Approval and payment. Requests up to EUR 500 can be approved by your manager. Requests above EUR 500, and any request involving travel outside the EU, also need approval from the division's learning partner. Wherever possible, the Learning team pays the provider directly so that you do not have to claim the cost back.

If an employee leaves Halcyra within 12 months of completing a course that cost more than EUR 2,000, they may be asked to repay part of the cost, as set out in the training agreement signed before booking.

sources.title: Halcyra Biotech - Tuition Support for Degree Programmes
sources.text:
Tuition support is separate from the divisional learning and development budgets. It helps employees who want to complete a longer qualification, such as a part-time bachelor's or master's degree, a doctorate, or a chartered professional qualification that takes more than a year to complete.

Employees with at least 12 months of service and a current performance rating of 'meets expectations' or above can apply. Halcyra will cover up to 75% of tuition fees, to a maximum of EUR 6,000 per academic year, for a qualification that is relevant to the employee's career at Halcyra. Fees for resits, late registration, accommodation and travel are not covered.

Applications are reviewed twice a year, in March and September, by a panel that includes a representative from People and a senior leader from the applicant's division. The panel considers business relevance, the employee's development plan and the funding available.

Employees who receive tuition support sign an agreement that requires them to repay part of the fees if they leave Halcyra within two years of completing the qualification, or if they withdraw from the programme without good reason.

Tuition support is paid directly to the institution at the start of each academic year.

sources.title: Halcyra Biotech - Conference Attendance and Presenting
sources.text:
Attending scientific conferences is an important part of how Halcyra researchers share and learn. This page explains how attendance is organised. The cost of attending is normally paid from the relevant learning and development budget, unless you are presenting.

If you have had an abstract, poster or talk accepted, the Scientific Communications team will pay your registration fee, travel and accommodation from the central communications budget, so the trip does not reduce your learning budget. Send the acceptance letter to Scientific Communications at least six weeks before the event.

Before presenting any Halcyra data externally, you must get clearance from the Publication Review Board. The board meets every two weeks and needs the final slides or poster at least ten working days before the event.

To avoid too many colleagues attending the same event, no more than four employees from one department may attend a single conference unless a director agrees otherwise. Attendees are expected to share a short summary of what they learned with their team within a month of returning.

Travel to conferences is booked through the travel portal and follows the standard business travel policy.

question: Can Tamberlyn staff finish early on Fridays?
answer: Between 5 June and 28 August 2026, employees may not finish work at 1 pm on Fridays without using annual leave.

sources.title: Tamberlyn Housing Association - Flexi-Time Scheme
sources.text:
Most office-based roles at Tamberlyn are part of the flexi-time scheme. Under the scheme you can choose when to start and finish work within a bandwidth of 7:30 am to 7 pm, as long as you are at work during the core hours of 10 am to 12 noon and 2 pm to 4 pm from Monday to Thursday, and 10 am to 12 noon on Fridays.

Hours are recorded in the Timesheets section of the staff portal and balanced over a four-week accounting period. You may carry a credit of up to 15 hours, or a debit of up to 7 hours, from one accounting period to the next. Any credit above 15 hours at the end of a period is lost unless your manager agreed in advance that the extra hours were needed.

With your manager's approval, you can use flexi credit to take up to two full flexi days in each accounting period. Half flexi days can be taken in the morning or the afternoon.

Neighbourhood officers, repairs operatives and contact centre staff work to rotas and are not part of the flexi-time scheme. Their working arrangements are set out in their contracts.

sources.title: Tamberlyn Housing Association - Summer Working Hours 2026
sources.text:
Tamberlyn Housing Association is running its summer working hours scheme again this year to give colleagues more time to rest during the long days of summer.

Between 5 June and 28 August 2026, employees may finish work at 1 pm on Fridays without using annual leave. Outside this period, normal working hours apply, and an early finish on a Friday must be covered by annual leave or flexi-time in the usual way.

Contracted hours do not change. Employees will be paid in full for the Friday afternoons they do not work, and they are not expected to make up the time on other days. Employees who do not normally work on a Friday do not receive an early finish on another day instead.

If an early-finish Friday falls on a day when an employee is on annual leave or off sick, it cannot be moved to another day. Teams should only arrange Friday afternoon meetings during the scheme where they are essential.

During the scheme, calls to the tenant contact centre after 1 pm on Fridays will be answered by our contracted out-of-hours service, and emergency repairs will be handled by the usual on-call contractors. Tenants were told about the change in the June newsletter.

sources.title: Tamberlyn Housing Association - Annual Leave and Bank Holidays
sources.text:
Full-time employees at Tamberlyn receive 26 days of annual leave a year, rising by one day for each complete year of service to a maximum of 31 days, plus the eight bank holidays. Part-time employees receive a pro-rata entitlement calculated in hours.

The leave year runs from 1 April to 31 March. Leave must be requested through the staff portal and approved by your manager before it is taken. Requests for more than ten consecutive working days should be made at least two months in advance.

Tamberlyn closes its offices between Christmas and New Year. Employees must keep three days of annual leave to cover the closure days that are not bank holidays; the dates are confirmed each September.

You may carry up to five days of unused leave into the next leave year. Exceptions above five days are only made where an employee has been unable to take leave because of long-term sickness or family leave.

Employees can also buy up to five additional days of leave each year through the salary sacrifice scheme, which opens for applications in February.

question: Will I pay a facility fee for an MRI at Fenwick Valley Imaging Center on the Larchwick Choice EPO?
answer: Choice EPO members pay no facility fee for an MRI at Fenwick Valley Imaging Center.

sources.title: Larchwick Health Choice EPO - Facility tiers and what you pay
sources.text:
The Larchwick Choice EPO sorts network hospitals, surgery centers, and imaging centers into two tiers based on cost and quality measures. The tier of the facility, not the doctor, determines the facility fee you pay.

Tier 1 facilities
Outpatient services at a Tier 1 facility have no facility fee. You still pay any copay or coinsurance that applies to the professional services you receive.

Tier 2 facilities
Outpatient services at a Tier 2 facility have a $150 facility fee per visit, in addition to any professional copay or coinsurance. The facility fee does not apply to emergency room visits.

Finding a facility's tier
The tier for each facility is shown in the Larchwick provider directory next to the facility name. Facility tiers are reviewed every January, and a facility's tier can change at that time.

sources.title: Larchwick Health network news - New imaging center joins the network
sources.text:
Larchwick Health is expanding imaging options for Choice EPO members in the eastern part of the county. Fenwick Valley Imaging Center joined the Larchwick network on March 1, 2026, and offers MRI, CT, ultrasound, and mammography services.

The center is open weekdays from 7 a.m. to 8 p.m. and Saturdays from 8 a.m. to 2 p.m. Free parking is available in the lot behind the building. Your doctor can send an imaging order electronically, or you can bring a paper order to your appointment. Members can book directly by phone or through the Larchwick app.

Members who already have an imaging appointment scheduled elsewhere do not need to move it. Prior authorization requirements for MRI and CT scans are the same at Fenwick Valley as at any other network imaging center.

gold.target_claim: Larchwick Choice EPO members pay no facility fee for an MRI at Fenwick Valley Imaging Center.

gold_spans.quote: Outpatient services at a Tier 1 facility have no facility fee.
Fenwick Valley Imaging Center joined the Larchwick network on March 1, 2026

construction.note: Claim needs S1 (Tier 1 = no facility fee) plus S2 (Fenwick Valley is in the network) plus the unstated bridge that Fenwick Valley is Tier 1; no passage gives its tier, and Tier 2 facilities charge $150.

question: Does Duskmere cover weight management medications for members with a BMI of 30 or higher?
answer: Duskmere Advantage members with a BMI of 30 or higher are covered for weight management medications.

sources.title: Duskmere Mutual - About the Healthy Weight program
sources.text:
The Duskmere Healthy Weight program is a 12-month lifestyle program that combines coaching, nutrition support, and activity tracking. There is no cost to participate.

Who can join
The program is open to adult members on any Duskmere plan who have a body mass index (BMI) of 30 or higher, or a BMI of 27 or higher with a weight-related condition such as type 2 diabetes or high blood pressure.

How to join
Complete an online health questionnaire and schedule your first coaching call. Your enrollment becomes active after the first call is completed. Spaces in each monthly group are limited, so there may be a waiting list.

What participants do
Participants meet with a coach every two weeks, log meals and activity in the Duskmere app, and attend a monthly group session by video.

sources.title: Duskmere Mutual - Coverage for weight management medications
sources.text:
Duskmere Mutual covers certain prescription medications for chronic weight management on its Advantage and Advantage Plus plans. Because these medications are expensive and work best alongside lifestyle support, coverage comes with conditions.

Who is covered
Weight management medications are covered for members who are enrolled in the Duskmere Healthy Weight program at the time the prescription is filled. Coverage continues for as long as the member stays enrolled and the prescribing doctor confirms progress every six months.

What you pay
Covered weight management medications are Tier 3 drugs and cost $75 for a 30-day supply after the pharmacy deductible.

Prior authorization
Your doctor must request prior authorization before the first fill. Duskmere will check program enrollment when it reviews the request.

gold.target_claim: Duskmere Advantage members with a BMI of 30 or higher are covered for weight management medications.

gold_spans.quote: Weight management medications are covered for members who are enrolled in the Duskmere Healthy Weight program at the time the prescription is filled.
The program is open to adult members on any Duskmere plan who have a body mass index (BMI) of 30 or higher

construction.note: S2 ties coverage to program enrollment and S1 ties program eligibility to BMI; the claim needs the unstated bridge that every eligible member is enrolled; S1 says enrollment needs a completed coaching call and may be waitlisted, so the passages do not jointly entail it.

question: How many chiropractic visits does the Sabledown Health Plus 2000 plan cover each year?
answer: The Sabledown Health Plus 2000 plan covers up to 24 chiropractic visits per plan year.

sources.title: Sabledown Health Plus 2000 - Summary of benefits: rehabilitation and chiropractic
sources.text:
The Sabledown Health Plus 2000 plan covers outpatient rehabilitation to help you recover from an injury, surgery, or illness.

Physical, occupational, and speech therapy
Outpatient therapy visits cost $35 per visit after the deductible. The plan covers up to 30 visits per plan year for physical and occupational therapy combined, and up to 30 visits per plan year for speech therapy. Therapy must be ordered by a doctor and provided by a licensed therapist in the Sabledown network.

Chiropractic care
Chiropractic visits cost $30 per visit and are not subject to the deductible. The plan covers up to 20 chiropractic visits per plan year. X-rays taken in a chiropractor's office are covered under the plan's diagnostic imaging benefit.

Massage therapy
Massage therapy is not covered, even when recommended by a chiropractor or physical therapist.

sources.title: Sabledown Health Plus 2000 - Member handbook, section 7: alternative and complementary care
sources.text:
This section explains how the Plus 2000 plan treats chiropractic care, acupuncture, and other complementary services.

Chiropractic care
Spinal manipulation and related chiropractic services are covered when provided by a licensed chiropractor in the Sabledown network. The Plus 2000 plan covers up to 24 chiropractic visits per plan year. Visits beyond the annual limit are not covered, even if your chiropractor recommends more treatment.

Acupuncture
Acupuncture is covered for chronic low back pain and for nausea related to chemotherapy or pregnancy, up to 10 visits per plan year. Acupuncture visits cost the same as a specialist visit and must be provided by a licensed acupuncturist.

Other services
Biofeedback is covered only for urinary incontinence and chronic migraine when ordered by a doctor. Naturopathy, homeopathy, and hypnotherapy are not covered under any Sabledown plan.

gold.target_claim: The Sabledown Health Plus 2000 plan covers up to 24 chiropractic visits per plan year.

gold_spans.quote: The Plus 2000 plan covers up to 24 chiropractic visits per plan year.

question: What is the copay right now for an in-network outpatient mental health office visit on the Hollisford Standard PPO?

sources.title: Hollisford Mutual - Behavioral health benefit update
sources.text:
Updated July 2026: Beginning August 1, 2026, in-network outpatient mental health office visits on the Standard PPO have a $0 copay. This replaces the $35 copay shown in earlier versions of the Standard PPO behavioral health summary.

What else changes
Group therapy sessions also move to a $0 copay on the same date. Cost sharing for intensive outpatient programs and inpatient care is unchanged.

Why we made this change
Members told us that cost was one of the main reasons they delayed or stopped therapy. Removing the copay for routine outpatient visits makes it easier to start and continue care.

Do I need to do anything?
No. Claims for visits on or after August 1, 2026 will be processed with the new $0 copay automatically. If you were charged a copay for a visit on or after that date, contact Member Services for a refund.

Outpatient care

Inpatient care
Inpatient mental health and substance use treatment are covered at 20% coinsurance after the deductible and require approval within one business day of admission.

Emergency care
Emergency mental health care is covered under the plan's emergency room benefit.

Finding a provider

question: Does the Myrtlecombe Core Plan cover hearing aids?
answer: Hearing aids are covered under the Myrtlecombe Core Plan.

sources.title: Myrtlecombe Core Plan - Routine vision care
sources.text:
The Myrtlecombe Core Plan covers one routine eye exam every plan year at a $15 copay when you see a network optometrist or ophthalmologist. The exam includes a check of how well you see, a test for glaucoma, and an eye health exam with dilation when your eye doctor decides it is needed.

Glasses and contact lenses
For members age 19 and older, the Core Plan provides an allowance of $120 every 24 months toward frames, lenses, or contact lenses from a network provider. Any amount over the allowance is your responsibility. For members under 19, one pair of glasses from the network collection is covered each plan year.

Medical eye care
Visits for eye conditions such as infections, injuries, or cataracts are medical care, not routine vision care, and are covered at your specialist copay.

sources.title: Myrtlecombe Core Plan - Hearing care
sources.text:
Hearing care under the Myrtlecombe Core Plan includes testing to find out whether you have hearing loss and, if so, how much.

Hearing exams
The Core Plan covers one routine hearing exam per plan year at no cost when you see a network audiologist or ear, nose, and throat specialist. Additional diagnostic hearing tests ordered by a doctor are covered at your specialist copay.

Hearing aids
Members sometimes see hearing aids listed as covered in our provider directory because many network audiologists also fit and sell them. However, the Core Plan does not cover hearing aids or the fitting of hearing aids. Members can buy hearing aids at a discount through the Myrtlecombe Extras program, which is a discount service and not insurance.

Cochlear implants
Cochlear implants are covered as a surgical benefit when medically necessary and approved in advance.

question: When did the Vantry dental rider premium go up to $29?
answer: Vantry's dental rider premium increased to $29 per covered member on January 1, 2026.

sources.title: Vantry Health Plan - Notice of dental rider premium change
sources.text:
Vantry Health Plan offers an optional dental rider that members can add to any Vantry medical plan. This notice explains a change to the rider's monthly premium.

What is changing
The monthly premium for the dental rider will rise from $24 to $29 per covered member. The new premium takes effect on July 1, 2026. Bills issued before that date reflect the current premium of $24.

Why the premium is changing
The cost of dental services in the Vantry service area has risen over the past two years, and more members are using the rider's coverage for crowns and root canals.

What stays the same
The rider's benefits do not change. Preventive dental care remains covered at no cost, basic services remain covered at 20% coinsurance, and the annual benefit maximum remains $1,250 per member.

Your options
You can keep the rider at the new premium or remove it at any time from your online account.

sources.title: Vantry Health Plan - Adding or removing an optional rider
sources.text:
Optional riders add benefits that your Vantry medical plan does not include, such as dental, vision hardware, or international travel coverage. Each rider has its own monthly premium, which is added to your medical plan bill.

Adding a rider
You can add a dental or vision rider during open enrollment or within 30 days of joining a Vantry medical plan. The international travel rider can be added at any time, at least 7 days before your departure date.

Removing a rider
You can remove any rider at any time. The rider ends on the last day of the month in which you remove it, and no partial-month refunds are given.

Waiting periods
If you remove the dental rider and add it again later, a 6-month waiting period applies to basic services such as fillings before they are covered again.

question: I buy my own Halverin plan. Will joining Healthy Beginnings reduce what I pay for my delivery stay?
answer: For members who buy an individual Halverin plan, Halverin waives the inpatient hospital copay for the delivery stay when the member joins Healthy Beginnings before the end of the second trimester.

sources.title: Halverin Health - Adding your newborn to your coverage
sources.text:
Your newborn is covered automatically for the first 30 days after birth under the parent's Halverin plan. To keep coverage after that, you must add the baby as a dependent.

How to add your baby
If you buy your own individual Halverin plan, add your baby through your Halverin online account or by calling Member Services. If you have coverage through an employer, contact your employer's benefits office, which will send the change to Halverin.

Deadline
Requests must be received within 60 days of the birth. When the request is received on time, coverage is continuous from the date of birth.

What you will need
Have the baby's full name and date of birth ready. The baby's tax identification number can be added later once it is issued. Adding a baby may change your premium starting with the month of birth.

sources.title: Halverin Health - Healthy Beginnings maternity program
sources.text:
Healthy Beginnings supports Halverin members through pregnancy, delivery, and the first months after birth. Members can join at any point during pregnancy by calling the Healthy Beginnings line or enrolling in the Halverin app.

What the program includes
Each participant is paired with a maternity nurse who checks in at least once a month, answers questions between prenatal visits, and helps plan for delivery. Participants also receive a free breast pump and access to online childbirth classes.

Delivery stay savings
For members enrolled through an employer group plan, Halverin waives the inpatient hospital copay for the delivery stay when the member joins Healthy Beginnings before the end of the second trimester.

After delivery
The maternity nurse continues to check in for 12 weeks after birth, including a screening for postpartum depression at the six-week mark.

question: What do Pellagrine members pay for a virtual visit in 2026?
answer: Silver 4000 members pay $0 per virtual visit from January 1 through June 30, 2026.

sources.title: Pellagrine Health Partners - Virtual care benefits for 2026
sources.text:
Pellagrine Virtual Care connects members with licensed clinicians by video or phone. Virtual visits are suited to minor illnesses, rashes, medication questions, and follow-up care that does not need a physical exam.

What you pay
Your cost for a virtual visit depends on your plan. Bronze 7000 members pay $0 per virtual visit from January 1 through June 30, 2026, after which the copay becomes $45 per virtual visit for the rest of the plan year. Silver 4000 members pay a $20 copay per virtual visit throughout the 2026 plan year. Gold 1500 members pay a $10 copay per virtual visit throughout the 2026 plan year. On every plan, the virtual visit copay applies whether or not you have met your deductible.

Therapy by video
Video sessions with an in-network therapist are billed as behavioral health office visits, not as virtual visits, and follow the behavioral health cost sharing in your plan summary.

When not to use virtual care
Virtual visits cannot be used for emergencies, for prescriptions of controlled substances, or for conditions that need same-day lab work. If the clinician decides you need to be seen in person, you will not be charged for the virtual visit.

sources.title: Pellagrine Health Partners - 2026 individual plans at a glance
sources.text:
Pellagrine Health Partners offers three individual plans for 2026. Each plan uses the Pellagrine Select network and covers the same set of essential health benefits; the plans differ in how costs are shared.

Bronze 7000
Individual deductible of $7,000 and out-of-pocket maximum of $9,100. After the deductible, most services are covered at 40% coinsurance.

Silver 4000
Individual deductible of $4,000 and out-of-pocket maximum of $8,500. After the deductible, most services are covered at 25% coinsurance. Members with household incomes within the Pellagrine Cost Share Assist range may qualify for a reduced deductible.

Gold 1500
Individual deductible of $1,500 and out-of-pocket maximum of $6,000. After the deductible, most services are covered at 15% coinsurance.

All three plans cover preventive care at no cost and include access to the Pellagrine Virtual Care service. Copays for specific services, including virtual visits, are listed in each plan's summary of benefits.

sources.title: Pellagrine Virtual Care - Getting ready for your first visit
sources.text:
You can join a Pellagrine Virtual Care visit from the Pellagrine mobile app or from a web browser on a computer with a camera and microphone.

Before your visit
Sign in with your member ID and date of birth, then confirm the phone number where the clinician can reach you if the video connection drops. Have a list of your current medications and any allergies ready. If the visit is for a child under 18, a parent or guardian must be present for the whole visit.

Connection tips
A connection of at least 2 megabits per second gives the best video quality. If your video freezes, the clinician will first try to reconnect and then call the phone number on file to finish the visit by voice.

After your visit
A visit summary appears in the app within one hour. If the clinician sends a prescription, it goes to the pharmacy you selected during sign-in. You can rate your clinician and leave comments from the visit summary screen.

sources.title: Pellagrine Virtual Care - Getting ready for your first visit
sources.text:
You can join a Pellagrine Virtual Care visit from the Pellagrine mobile app or from a web browser on a computer with a camera and microphone.

Before your visit
Sign in with your member ID and date of birth, then confirm the phone number where the clinician can reach you if the video connection drops. Have a list of your current medications and any allergies ready. If the visit is for a child under 18, a parent or guardian must be present for the whole visit.

Connection tips
A connection of at least 2 megabits per second gives the best video quality. If your video freezes, the clinician will first try to reconnect and then call the phone number on file to finish the visit by voice.

After your visit
A visit summary appears in the app within one hour. If the clinician sends a prescription, it goes to the pharmacy you selected during sign-in. You can rate your clinician and leave comments from the visit summary screen.

question: What dental cleanings does the Thistlegate Horizon HMO cover?

sources.title: Thistlegate Horizon HMO - Pediatric dental and vision benefits, 2026 plan year
sources.text:
The Thistlegate Horizon HMO includes dental and vision benefits for children as part of its 2026 benefits package. These services are provided through the Thistlegate dental and vision networks, and no referral from your primary care physician is needed.

Dental
For members under age 19, the plan covers 2 routine cleanings and exams per plan year at no cost. Fillings are covered at 30% coinsurance. Medically necessary orthodontia is covered at 50% coinsurance after a separate $350 orthodontia deductible. Adult dental care is not part of the Horizon HMO; members age 19 and older who want dental coverage can buy the separate Thistlegate Dental Plus policy.

Vision
Members under age 19 receive one comprehensive eye exam per plan year and either one pair of prescription glasses from the network frame collection or a 12-month supply of contact lenses. Adults receive one eye exam every 24 months with a $25 copay; glasses and contact lenses for adults are not covered.

sources.title: Thistlegate Horizon HMO - Choosing your primary care physician
sources.text:
Every Horizon HMO member needs a primary care physician (PCP) from the Thistlegate network. Your PCP handles routine care and refers you to specialists when you need them.

Picking a PCP
You can choose any network PCP who is accepting new patients. Each family member can have a different PCP, and children can see a pediatrician as their PCP. If you do not choose a PCP within 30 days of enrolling, Thistlegate will assign one near your home address.

Changing your PCP
You can change your PCP once a month by calling Member Services or using the Thistlegate app. The change takes effect on the first day of the following month.

Specialist referrals
For most specialist care, your PCP must send a referral before your visit. You do not need a referral for in-network OB-GYN care, behavioral health visits, or urgent care. Care from a non-network provider is not covered except in an emergency.

sources.title: Thistlegate Health Plans - Paying your premium
sources.text:
Your monthly premium keeps your Thistlegate coverage active. Premiums are due on the first day of each month for that month's coverage.

Ways to pay
You can pay online with a bank account or debit card, set up automatic monthly payments, or mail a check to the address on your billing statement. Payments made online post to your account within two business days.

Grace period
If you receive a premium subsidy through the Thistlegate Assist program, you have a three-month grace period to pay an overdue premium. Without a subsidy, the grace period is 31 days. During the grace period, Thistlegate may hold claims until the overdue premium is paid.

If coverage ends for nonpayment
If the grace period ends without full payment, coverage ends on the last day of the period for which premium was paid. You can reapply during the next open enrollment period or after a qualifying life event.

question: When does Wrenhollow coverage start if I enroll during open enrollment for 2027?
answer: If you enroll and select a plan between November 1 and December 15, 2026, your coverage begins on February 1, 2027.

sources.title: Wrenhollow Care Cooperative - Help paying your premium
sources.text:
The Wrenhollow Member Assistance Fund lowers monthly premiums for individual and family plan members with limited household income. The fund is paid for by the cooperative and is separate from any government program.

Who qualifies
Households with income at or below 250% of the regional income benchmark published by Wrenhollow each October can apply. Members must live in the Wrenhollow service area and must not be eligible for an employer plan that meets Wrenhollow's affordability standard.

How much it pays
Assistance ranges from $40 to $310 per member per month, depending on household size and income. The amount is applied directly to your bill, so you pay only the remaining premium.

How to apply
Apply with the same form you use to enroll, or add an application later from your online account. You will need recent pay stubs or last year's tax return. Approved assistance starts with the next monthly bill and must be renewed every year.

sources.title: Wrenhollow Care Cooperative - Ending your coverage
sources.text:
You can end your Wrenhollow individual or family plan at any time. This page explains when coverage ends and what happens to premiums you have already paid.

How to cancel
Sign in to your online account and choose End Coverage, or call Member Services. You can cancel coverage for the whole household or for one member only.

When coverage ends
If you ask to end coverage on a date at least 14 days in the future, coverage ends on that date. If you ask with less notice, coverage ends 14 days after your request, unless you are ending coverage because you enrolled in other health coverage, in which case it can end the day before the new coverage starts.

Premium refunds
If you paid premiums for any month after your coverage ends, Wrenhollow refunds the overpayment to your original payment method within 30 days. Partial months are refunded on a daily basis.

If a member dies
Coverage ends on the date of death, and any premium paid for later dates is refunded to the estate.

sources.title: Wrenhollow Care Cooperative - Enrolling in an individual plan for 2027
sources.text:
Wrenhollow Care Cooperative sells individual and family health plans directly to residents of its service area. Open enrollment for 2027 coverage runs from November 1, 2026 through January 15, 2027.

When your coverage starts
If you enroll and select a plan between November 1 and December 15, 2026, your coverage begins on January 1, 2027. If you enroll between December 16, 2026 and January 15, 2027, your coverage begins on February 1, 2027. Your first premium payment must be received before your coverage start date, or the enrollment will be canceled.

After open enrollment ends
After January 15, 2027, you can enroll only if you qualify for a special enrollment period, for example after moving into the service area, losing other coverage, or having or adopting a child. Special enrollment requests must be submitted within 60 days of the qualifying event.

Renewing members
Members who have a Wrenhollow plan in 2026 are automatically renewed into the same plan for 2027 unless they choose a different plan by December 15, 2026.

sources.title: Wrenhollow Care Cooperative - Help paying your premium
sources.text:
The Wrenhollow Member Assistance Fund lowers monthly premiums for individual and family plan members with limited household income. The fund is paid for by the cooperative and is separate from any government program.

Who qualifies
Households with income at or below 250% of the regional income benchmark published by Wrenhollow each October can apply. Members must live in the Wrenhollow service area and must not be eligible for an employer plan that meets Wrenhollow's affordability standard.

How much it pays
Assistance ranges from $40 to $310 per member per month, depending on household size and income. The amount is applied directly to your bill, so you pay only the remaining premium.

How to apply
Apply with the same form you use to enroll, or add an application later from your online account. You will need recent pay stubs or last year's tax return. Approved assistance starts with the next monthly bill and must be renewed every year.

sources.title: Wrenhollow Care Cooperative - Ending your coverage
sources.text:
You can end your Wrenhollow individual or family plan at any time. This page explains when coverage ends and what happens to premiums you have already paid.

How to cancel
Sign in to your online account and choose End Coverage, or call Member Services. You can cancel coverage for the whole household or for one member only.

When coverage ends
If you ask to end coverage on a date at least 14 days in the future, coverage ends on that date. If you ask with less notice, coverage ends 14 days after your request, unless you are ending coverage because you enrolled in other health coverage, in which case it can end the day before the new coverage starts.

Premium refunds
If you paid premiums for any month after your coverage ends, Wrenhollow refunds the overpayment to your original payment method within 30 days. Partial months are refunded on a daily basis.

If a member dies
Coverage ends on the date of death, and any premium paid for later dates is refunded to the estate.

sources.title: Wrenhollow Care Cooperative - Enrolling in an individual plan for 2027
sources.text:
Wrenhollow Care Cooperative sells individual and family health plans directly to residents of its service area. Open enrollment for 2027 coverage runs from November 1, 2026 through January 15, 2027.

When your coverage starts
If you enroll and select a plan between November 1 and December 15, 2026, your coverage begins on January 1, 2027. If you enroll between December 16, 2026 and January 15, 2027, your coverage begins on February 1, 2027. Your first premium payment must be received before your coverage start date, or the enrollment will be canceled.

After open enrollment ends
After January 15, 2027, you can enroll only if you qualify for a special enrollment period, for example after moving into the service area, losing other coverage, or having or adopting a child. Special enrollment requests must be submitted within 60 days of the qualifying event.

Renewing members
Members who have a Wrenhollow plan in 2026 are automatically renewed into the same plan for 2027 unless they choose a different plan by December 15, 2026.
