question: How are gift returns refunded at Ostara Kitchenworks? Please cite your source.
answer: Gift returns are refunded as an Ostara Kitchenworks e-gift card in the recipient's name [S3].

sources.title: Holiday Returns 2026 - Ostara Kitchenworks
sources.text:
To give you more time with gifts, Ostara Kitchenworks is extending its return window for the holiday season. Orders delivered between November 1 and December 31, 2026 qualify for an extended return window of 60 days from delivery.

The extended window covers cookware, bakeware, cutlery, small appliances and kitchen textiles. Items must be unused and returned in their original packaging, including any inserts and protective sleeves. Knives that have been sharpened by anyone other than Ostara Kitchenworks cannot be returned.

Engraved and monogrammed items are final sale and are not eligible for return at any time of year. Clearance items marked Final Sale on the product page are also excluded from the holiday extension.

Gift recipients can start a return with the gift receipt code printed on the packing slip. Refunds for gift returns are issued as an Ostara Kitchenworks e-gift card in the recipient's name, and the original purchaser is not notified.

Once your return reaches our warehouse, please allow up to 10 business days for it to be inspected and refunded. During January, inspection can take a few days longer because of seasonal volume.

sources.title: Holiday Shipping Deadlines - Ostara Kitchenworks
sources.text:
Want your Ostara Kitchenworks order to arrive by December 24? Use the dates below as a guide for addresses in the contiguous United States.

Standard shipping: order by December 14.
Two-Day shipping: order by December 19 before noon Eastern time.
Overnight shipping: order by December 22 before noon Eastern time.

Cast-iron and enamelled Dutch ovens ship from a separate warehouse and may arrive in their own box a day or two after the rest of your order. Orders that include engraving need an extra 3 business days before they ship, so please place them by December 9 if you are using Standard shipping.

Our warehouse is closed on December 25 and January 1, and orders placed on those days ship on the next business day. Carriers sometimes miss their delivery estimates during the busiest weeks of the season, and we are unable to guarantee arrival dates for any shipping method.

sources.title: Price Adjustments - Ostara Kitchenworks
sources.text:
If an item you bought from Ostara Kitchenworks goes down in price within 14 days of delivery, we will refund the difference. Contact our support team with your order number and a link to the product page showing the lower price. Price adjustments are made to the original payment method.

Price adjustments are available once per item and only for the same product, colour and size. They do not apply to prices offered by other retailers, to limited-quantity doorbuster deals, or to bundle discounts where the item was sold as part of a set.

If you have already returned the item, or if the lower price required a promotional code that has since expired, we cannot adjust the price. Price adjustments for gift purchases are made to the original purchaser, not the gift recipient, so the recipient's gift receipt is not affected.

gold.target_claim: Ostara Kitchenworks refunds gift returns as an e-gift card in the recipient's name.

gold_spans.quote: Refunds for gift returns are issued as an Ostara Kitchenworks e-gift card in the recipient's name

construction.note: Reuses s6-f3 sources. The claim is supported by S1, but the answer cites S3 (price adjustments), which mentions gift purchases and gift receipts and so looks plausible as a citation while saying nothing about how gift returns are refunded.

question: How long are sealed-system parts covered on a Fennick refrigerator? Please cite your source.
answer: Parts for the sealed refrigeration system in Fennick refrigerators and freezers are covered for 5 years [S2].

sources.title: Fennick Appliance Limited Warranty
sources.text:
Every new Fennick refrigerator, range, dishwasher, washer and dryer comes with a 1-year limited warranty covering parts and labour from the date of delivery. During this period, Fennick or an authorised service partner will repair defects in materials or workmanship at no charge.

The sealed refrigeration system on refrigerators and freezers is covered for parts for 5 years. The sealed system includes the compressor, condenser, evaporator, drier and connecting tubing. Labour for sealed-system repairs after the first year is charged at the service partner's standard rate.

2026 Registration Bonus
Appliances registered online between April 1 and September 30, 2026 receive a second year of parts and labour coverage at no extra cost. To register, you will need the model and serial numbers from the rating label, which is usually found inside the door or on the back panel.

The limited warranty covers appliances used for normal household purposes in the United States and Canada. It does not cover commercial use, damage from improper installation, power surges, or cosmetic damage reported more than 30 days after delivery. Replacement water filters and light bulbs are consumable parts and are not covered.

sources.title: Fennick Protection Plus Service Plans
sources.text:
Fennick Protection Plus is an optional service plan that you can buy for any Fennick appliance at any time while its original limited warranty is still active. Plans are available in 3-year and 5-year terms, and each term begins on the day the plan is purchased.

Protection Plus covers mechanical and electrical failures from normal use, including parts, labour and the technician's travel charge. It also covers food spoilage of up to $250 per claim if a covered refrigerator or freezer failure causes food to be thrown away, as long as you provide receipts or a written list of the items.

Plans are priced by appliance type. A 3-year plan for a dishwasher costs $129, and a 5-year plan for a refrigerator costs $289. Prices include all taxes where taxes apply.

You can cancel Protection Plus within 30 days of purchase for a full refund. After 30 days, cancellations receive a prorated refund minus any claims paid. Protection Plus is a separate contract from the Fennick limited warranty and has its own terms and conditions.

sources.title: Requesting Warranty Service - Fennick Appliances
sources.text:
If your Fennick appliance stops working as it should, start a service request online or call our appliance support line. Have the model and serial numbers ready, along with the date of delivery and a short description of the problem.

Before booking a technician, our support team will walk you through a few quick checks. Many reported faults, such as a dishwasher that will not start or a dryer that runs cold, turn out to be a tripped breaker, a child lock, or a blocked vent, and can be fixed in minutes.

If a technician visit is needed, an authorised service partner will contact you to arrange a time. Please make sure the appliance is accessible, with at least 60 cm of clear space in front of it, and that an adult is home for the visit. Built-in appliances must be removable from their cabinetry without damaging it.

Service is available in the United States and Canada only. In some rural areas the nearest service partner may be more than 100 miles away; in these cases we may arrange a mail-in repair for smaller items or send a replacement part that you can fit yourself with video guidance.

gold.target_claim: Fennick covers parts for the sealed refrigeration system in refrigerators and freezers for 5 years.

gold_spans.quote: The sealed refrigeration system on refrigerators and freezers is covered for parts for 5 years.

construction.note: Reuses s6-f6 sources. The claim is supported by S1, but the answer cites S2 (Protection Plus), whose 5-year plan terms and refrigerator pricing make it a tempting but wrong citation.

question: Can I return opened makeup to Juniper Lane Beauty?
answer: Juniper Lane Beauty gives a full refund on opened skincare and makeup returned within 30 days of delivery.

sources.title: Shade Matching, Samples and Rewards - Juniper Lane Beauty
sources.text:
Not sure which foundation shade to choose? Juniper Lane's shade-matching chat is staffed by trained makeup artists from 9 a.m. to 9 p.m. Eastern time every day. Upload a photo taken in daylight without filters, and they will suggest up to three shades across our brands.

You can also request up to three free deluxe samples with any order over $35. Samples are chosen at checkout from the list shown in your bag, and availability changes weekly. Foundation samples come in single-use sachets so you can test a shade for a full day before buying the full size.

Members of Juniper Lane Rewards earn 1 point for every dollar spent and can redeem 500 points for a $10 reward. Points are deducted if an order is refunded, and rewards cannot be used toward gift cards.

Our skincare consultants can also recommend a routine based on your skin type and concerns. Consultations take place by chat or video call, are free, and can be booked for any day of the week.

sources.title: Returning Beauty Products - Juniper Lane Beauty
sources.text:
We want you to love what you buy from Juniper Lane Beauty. Unopened products in their original condition can be returned within 60 days of delivery for a full refund to the original payment method.

Opened skincare and makeup can be returned for a full refund within 30 days of delivery, but only if at least half of the product remains and only for one opened item per account in any 12-month period. If a shade or formula turns out not to suit you, our shade-matching chat can help you find a better match for next time.

Fragrances can be returned only if the cellophane wrap is unbroken. Hair tools such as dryers and straighteners can be returned within 30 days if they have been used no more than twice, and they must be sent back with all attachments.

Gift sets are returned as a whole; we cannot accept part of a set. Products marked as samples or travel minis that came free with an order do not need to be returned and do not affect your refund.

question: How much would Brackwater Electronics keep as a restocking fee if I return my opened Halden X2 projector?
answer: Returning an opened Halden X2 projector to Brackwater Electronics costs a restocking fee of $74.85.

sources.title: Halden X2 Portable Projector - Product Details
sources.text:
The Halden X2 is a compact 1080p projector designed for movie nights at home and presentations on the go. It weighs 1.4 kg and runs for up to 3 hours on its built-in battery, enough for most feature films.

The X2 projects images from 40 to 120 inches diagonally and includes automatic keystone correction and autofocus, so it can be set up on a coffee table or bookshelf without a tripod. Brightness is rated at 600 ANSI lumens, so it performs best in a dim room.

Connections include HDMI, USB-C with video input, and Bluetooth for external speakers. A built-in 8-watt speaker handles dialogue in smaller rooms, and the projector's streaming apps are updated over Wi-Fi.

In the box you will find the projector, a remote control with batteries, a 65-watt USB-C charger, a carrying pouch and a quick start guide. The Halden X2 is covered by a 1-year manufacturer warranty. Replacement remotes and pouches can be ordered from the accessories page.

sources.title: Returns on Opened Electronics - Brackwater Electronics
sources.text:
Brackwater Electronics accepts returns of most products within 30 days of delivery. Unopened products in their original sealed packaging are refunded in full.

Opened projectors, cameras, drones and VR headsets can be returned within the same 30-day window, but a restocking fee of 15 percent of the item's purchase price is deducted from the refund. The fee covers inspection, cleaning and repackaging so that the item can be resold as open-box stock. Brackwater Plus members are not charged a restocking fee on their first opened-item return each calendar year.

Opened laptops, tablets and phones have no restocking fee, but they must be returned with all accessories and with any activation locks or account passwords removed. Devices that are still locked to an account cannot be processed and will be sent back to you.

Software, game codes and gift cards cannot be returned once opened or redeemed. Ink and toner cartridges can be returned only if their foil seal is intact.

Refunds go back to the original payment method within 7 business days of the return passing inspection. Original shipping charges are not refunded unless the return is due to our error or a defect.

question: How long is the sleep trial on the Hollowmere Haven Foam mattress?
answer: The Haven Foam mattress comes with a 365-night sleep trial.

sources.title: Crestline Hybrid Mattress - Hollowmere Sleep
sources.text:
The Crestline Hybrid is Hollowmere Sleep's premium mattress, combining individually wrapped steel coils with three layers of cooling foam. It is 13 inches deep and comes in medium and firm feel options.

Sleep trial: every Crestline Hybrid comes with a 365-night sleep trial. If you decide it is not right for you at any point during the trial, contact us and we will arrange a free pickup and a full refund. There is no minimum number of nights you must try it first.

Warranty: the Crestline Hybrid is covered by a 15-year limited warranty against sagging deeper than 1 inch, broken coils and manufacturing defects in the cover.

The Crestline Hybrid ships compressed in a box and expands to its full height within 24 hours. A small amount of new-foam odour is normal and fades within a few days in a well-ventilated room. Use it on a firm, flat foundation or a slatted base with slats no more than 3 inches apart.

sources.title: Delivery and Old Mattress Removal - Hollowmere Sleep
sources.text:
Hollowmere Sleep mattresses ship free to addresses in the contiguous United States. Boxed mattresses usually arrive within 3 to 5 business days by ground carrier and are left at your door.

If you would like the mattress set up for you, choose In-Home Setup at checkout for $129. A two-person team will carry the mattress to your bedroom, unbox it, place it on your bed frame and take the packaging away. In-Home Setup deliveries are scheduled by phone and usually take place within 2 weeks of your order.

In-Home Setup customers can also add Old Mattress Removal for $49. The team will take away one mattress and one box spring, as long as they are free of bed bugs and have been bagged in the plastic cover we send ahead of the visit. Removed mattresses are sent to a recycling partner, where the steel, foam and fabric are separated.

Deliveries to Alaska and Hawaii are available for an additional charge shown at checkout.

sources.title: Haven Foam Mattress - Hollowmere Sleep
sources.text:
The Haven Foam is Hollowmere Sleep's all-foam mattress, designed for back and side sleepers who want gentle pressure relief at an accessible price. It is 10 inches deep and has a single medium feel.

Sleep trial: the Haven Foam comes with a 100-night sleep trial. Because your body needs time to adjust to a new mattress, we ask that you sleep on it for at least 30 nights before starting a return. Returns within the trial are refunded in full, and we arrange the pickup for you.

Warranty: the Haven Foam is covered by a 10-year limited warranty against sagging deeper than 1 inch and manufacturing defects.

The Haven Foam ships compressed in a box. Allow at least 12 hours for it to expand before sleeping on it. It can be used on a platform bed, slatted base, box spring or adjustable base.

every Crestline Hybrid comes with a 365-night sleep trial

question: How long do I have to return unworn shoes to Quillon Footwear?
answer: Quillon Footwear accepts returns of unworn shoes within 60 days of delivery.

sources.title: Help Centre - How do I send back shoes that don't fit?
sources.text:
Sorry they didn't work out! You have 60 days from delivery to return unworn shoes for a refund. Here is how it works:

1. Sign in to your Quillon account and open Order History.
2. Choose the pair you want to return and tell us why.
3. Print the return label we email you and attach it to a shipping box with the shoebox inside.
4. Drop the parcel at any carrier location.

If you need a different size instead, choose Exchange in step 2 and we will ship the new size as soon as your return is scanned.

Returns from gift orders are refunded as a Quillon gift card so the gift-giver is not notified. If you have any trouble printing the label, our support team can send you a QR code to use at the drop-off counter instead.

sources.title: Returns Policy - Quillon Footwear
sources.text:
Quillon Footwear accepts returns of unworn shoes within 45 days of delivery for a refund to the original payment method. Shoes must be returned in the original shoebox, placed inside a separate shipping box so that the shoebox itself arrives undamaged.

Shoes count as unworn if they have only been tried on indoors on a clean surface. Soles with dirt, scuffs or creasing from outdoor wear cannot be accepted, and those shoes will be sent back to you.

Return shipping within the United States costs $6, which is deducted from your refund. Exchanges for a different size are free of charge.

Socks, insoles and shoe-care products can be returned only if they are unopened. Custom-dyed sneakers from our Studio line are made to order and cannot be returned.

Refunds are processed within 5 business days of the return reaching our warehouse.

gold.target_claim: Quillon Footwear accepts returns of unworn shoes within 60 days of delivery.

question: How quickly do Corvel Home Expedited orders arrive?
answer: Expedited orders arrive the next business day if the order is placed before 2 p.m. Pacific time on a business day.

sources.title: White Glove Delivery for Furniture - Corvel Home
sources.text:
White Glove delivery is how Corvel Home ships large furniture, including sofas, sectionals, bed frames, dressers and dining tables. A two-person crew brings each item into the room of your choice, unpacks it, and takes the packaging away when they leave.

After your furniture reaches our regional delivery hub, our freight partner will contact you by phone and email to book a four-hour appointment window. Most customers receive their appointment within 2 to 4 weeks of ordering, although made-to-order upholstery can take up to 10 weeks to build before it reaches the hub.

White Glove delivery costs a flat $149 per order, however many large items are included. Bed frames and dining tables are assembled on site at no extra charge. The crew cannot wall-mount furniture, move your existing furniture, or carry items up more than three flights of stairs in a building without an elevator.

If you need to reschedule, please tell the freight partner at least 48 hours before your appointment. A missed appointment without notice may incur a $75 redelivery fee. Someone aged 18 or over must be present for the whole appointment to inspect the furniture and sign for it.

sources.title: Shipping Options and Delivery Times - Corvel Home
sources.text:
Corvel Home offers three delivery options at checkout for items that ship in a box, such as lamps, rugs, bedding, decor and small tables. The option you choose applies to the whole order.

Standard Ground orders typically arrive in 5 to 7 business days. Standard Ground is free on orders of $75 or more after discounts; below that amount it costs $7.95.

Expedited orders arrive in 3 business days and cost a flat $12.95 per order.

Priority Next-Day orders arrive the next business day if the order is placed before 2 p.m. Pacific time on a business day. Priority Next-Day costs $24.95 per order and is available only for addresses in the contiguous United States.

For Standard Ground and Expedited, delivery times are counted from the day your order leaves our warehouse in Reno, Nevada, and do not include any extra time needed if your payment is flagged for review. Business days are Monday through Friday, excluding federal holidays.

Sofas, sectionals, bed frames, dressers and dining tables are not eligible for Standard Ground, Expedited or Priority Next-Day. These items ship by White Glove freight only, and the delivery options shown at checkout update automatically when one of them is in your cart.

sources.title: Tracking Your Order - Corvel Home Help Center
sources.text:
When your boxed order leaves our warehouse, Corvel Home sends a shipping confirmation email with a tracking link for each package. Orders with several items may ship in more than one box, and each box can have its own tracking number and delivery date.

Tracking information usually appears within 24 hours of the confirmation email. If the link still shows 'label created' after 2 business days, the carrier may not have scanned the package yet, and the status will update at the next scan.

You can also see every package in the Orders section of your Corvel Home account. Signed-in customers can turn on text message updates there, including an alert when a package is out for delivery.

If tracking shows a package as delivered but you cannot find it, check around your property and with your neighbors, and wait until the end of the next business day, because carriers sometimes mark packages as delivered early. question: Do Thessaly headphones bought from the Thessaly online store come with spare ear cushions?
answer: Headphones purchased directly from the Thessaly Audio online store do not include a free replacement set of ear cushions during the warranty period.

sources.title: Where to Buy and Product Registration - Thessaly Audio
sources.text:
Thessaly Audio products are sold through our online store and through authorised retailers listed on our Where to Buy page. Authorised retailers receive stock directly from Thessaly Audio, and many offer in-store demonstrations and fitting help for our earbuds.

We recommend registering your product in the Thessaly Connect app within a few weeks of purchase. Registration lets us tell you about firmware updates and safety notices for your model, and it stores your serial number so you do not have to look for it later. Registration is optional and is not required to make a warranty claim.

Be careful when buying from online marketplace sellers who are not listed on the Where to Buy page. We regularly find counterfeit Thessaly earbuds offered at steep discounts, often in packaging that looks very close to the real thing. You can check whether a product is genuine by entering its serial number in the Thessaly Connect app; genuine serial numbers begin with the letters TA followed by nine digits.

If you think you have bought a counterfeit product, contact the seller or marketplace first, and then send us the listing details so our brand protection team can investigate.

sources.title: Returning a Thessaly Audio Order
sources.text:
If you bought from the Thessaly Audio online store and changed your mind, you can return the product within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Return shipping is free for customers in the United States; we email a prepaid label once your return request is approved.

For hygiene reasons, earbuds and in-ear monitors can be returned only if the ear tips are unused and still sealed in their bag. Over-ear and on-ear headphones can be returned after being tried on, as long as the cushions are clean and undamaged.

Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days of the return reaching our warehouse. If you paid with a gift card, the refund is added back to the same card.

Products bought from an authorised retailer must be returned to that retailer under its own return policy. We are unable to accept returns or issue refunds for purchases made elsewhere, although the Thessaly Audio warranty still applies to products bought from authorised retailers.

sources.title: Thessaly Audio Limited Warranty
sources.text:
Thessaly Audio warrants its headphones, earbuds and portable speakers against defects in materials and workmanship for 2 years from the original date of purchase. The warranty applies to the original purchaser and requires proof of purchase, such as an order confirmation or a dated receipt.

Headphones purchased directly from the Thessaly Audio online store include one free replacement set of ear cushions during the warranty period. To request your cushions, open a support ticket with your order number and the model name, and we will post them to the shipping address on the order.

Rechargeable batteries are covered against manufacturing defects for the full warranty period. Some loss of battery capacity with normal use is expected and is not treated as a defect unless capacity falls below 70 percent of the original rating within the first 12 months.

This warranty does not cover damage caused by drops, crushing, liquid exposure beyond the product's stated water-resistance rating, or repairs carried out by anyone other than Thessaly Audio or an authorised service partner. Cosmetic wear such as scratches, scuffs and fading is also excluded.

If we confirm a covered defect, we will repair the product or replace it with the same or an equivalent model, at our discretion. Replacement products are covered for the remainder of the original warranty period or 90 days, whichever is longer.

question: When did Wrenfield Apparel start shipping exchange replacements for free?
answer: Starting February 2, 2026, the replacement item ships free of charge when the exchange is requested through the online Returns Center.

sources.title: Size and Fit Guide - Wrenfield Apparel
sources.text:
Wrenfield Apparel sizes run true to size for most customers. Each product page lists garment measurements in both inches and centimetres, taken with the item laid flat.

To find your size, measure your chest at the fullest point, your natural waist, and your hips at the widest point, keeping the tape snug but not tight. Compare these numbers with the body measurements chart on the product page rather than with clothes you already own, since fits vary between brands.

Our merino and lambswool knitwear relaxes slightly with wear, so if you are between sizes for a sweater, we suggest choosing the smaller size. Our cotton denim has about 2 percent stretch and keeps its shape, so choose your usual size. Outerwear is cut with room for a mid-weight layer underneath.

Still unsure? Our Fit Advisors can help by live chat from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. Eastern time, seven days a week. Tell them your height, usual size and how you like your clothes to fit, and they will recommend a size for the item you are looking at.

sources.title: Exchanges - Wrenfield Apparel
sources.text:
Need a different size or colour? Wrenfield Apparel allows one exchange per item for another size or colour of the same style. You can request an exchange through the online Returns Center, in any Wrenfield store, or by calling Customer Care.

Starting March 2, 2026, the replacement item ships free of charge when the exchange is requested through the online Returns Center. Before that date, all exchange replacements were charged standard shipping.

When you submit an exchange request online, we reserve the replacement straight away and ship it as soon as the carrier scans your returning parcel. Store exchanges are completed on the spot if the store has your size in stock.

Items must be unworn and unwashed, with the original tags still attached. Exchanges are only available for items of equal price. If you would like a different style, please return the original item for a refund and place a new order. Items marked Final Sale cannot be exchanged.

If the size or colour you want sells out before your request is submitted, the Returns Center will offer you a refund instead.

sources.title: Changing or Cancelling an Order - Wrenfield Apparel
sources.text:
You can change or cancel a Wrenfield Apparel order for up to 60 minutes after you place it. Go to Order History in your account and choose Edit Order; you can change sizes, colours, quantities and the delivery address during this time.

After 60 minutes your order is sent to our fulfilment centre and can no longer be edited. If you still need a different size, you can request an exchange once the order arrives. If you no longer want the order, you can refuse the delivery or send it back after it arrives.

Orders paid with a buy-now-pay-later provider are cancelled through that provider's app as well as in your Wrenfield account, and the provider will update your payment plan within 2 business days.

Gift wrapping and gift messages can be added or removed during the 60-minute editing window but not afterwards. Personalised items, such as monogrammed scarves, cannot be cancelled once the order is placed.

sources.title: Changing or Cancelling an Order - Wrenfield Apparel
sources.text:
You can change or cancel a Wrenfield Apparel order for up to 60 minutes after you place it. Go to Order History in your account and choose Edit Order; you can change sizes, colours, quantities and the delivery address during this time.

After 60 minutes your order is sent to our fulfilment centre and can no longer be edited. If you still need a different size, you can request an exchange once the order arrives. If you no longer want the order, you can refuse the delivery or send it back after it arrives.

sources.title: Size and Fit Guide - Wrenfield Apparel
sources.text:
Wrenfield Apparel sizes run true to size for most customers. Each product page lists garment measurements in both inches and centimetres, taken with the item laid flat.

To find your size, measure your chest at the fullest point, your natural waist, and your hips at the widest point, keeping the tape snug but not tight. Compare these numbers with the body measurements chart on the product page rather than with clothes you already own, since fits vary between brands.

Our merino and lambswool knitwear relaxes slightly with wear, so if you are between sizes for a sweater, we suggest choosing the smaller size. Our cotton denim has about 2 percent stretch and keeps its shape, so choose your usual size. Outerwear is cut with room for a mid-weight layer underneath.

Still unsure? Our Fit Advisors can help by live chat from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. Eastern time, seven days a week. Tell them your height, usual size and how you like your clothes to fit, and they will recommend a size for the item you are looking at.

sources.title: Damaged or Broken Items - Lumivane Lighting
sources.text:
Every Lumivane shade is packed in a double-walled carton with moulded pulp inserts, but breakages occasionally happen in transit. If your lamp, shade or bulb arrives damaged, please let us know within 7 days of delivery.

To report damage, reply to your shipping confirmation email with your order number and photos of the damaged item, the inside of the box and the shipping label. Keep all the packaging until your claim is settled, because the carrier may ask to inspect it.

Once we receive your photos, we will send a replacement at no cost, usually within 3 business days. If the item is no longer in stock, we will refund the full price of the item, including any shipping you paid for it. You do not need to send the broken item back unless we specifically ask you to.

For international orders, replacements are sent by the same service as the original order and can take just as long to arrive. Please do not refuse an international parcel because the outer carton looks damaged; accept it, check the contents, and report any breakage to us.

sources.title: Shipping Within the United States - Lumivane Lighting
sources.text:
Lumivane Lighting ships to all 50 states from our warehouse in Ohio. Orders placed before 1 p.m. Eastern time on a business day usually leave the warehouse the same day.

Standard shipping takes 3 to 6 business days and is free on orders of $99 or more. Below $99, Standard shipping is a flat $8. Two-Day shipping is available for $22 to addresses in the contiguous United States.

Floor lamps and large pendant lights ship in oversized cartons and travel by ground freight. These orders cannot be upgraded to Two-Day shipping, and delivery to Alaska and Hawaii can take up to 14 business days.

We ship to P.O. boxes using the postal service, but oversized cartons cannot be delivered to a P.O. box. If your order contains an oversized item, please use a street address. Military APO and FPO addresses are supported for bulbs, shades and table lamps only.

sources.title: International Shipping - Lumivane Lighting
sources.text:
Lumivane Lighting ships lamps, shades and bulbs to 31 countries from our warehouse in Ohio. At checkout, international customers can choose between two services.

Economy International is delivered by postal partners and usually arrives in 8 to 15 business days. Economy International orders are shipped duties-unpaid to every destination, which means the recipient pays any import duties, taxes and carrier handling fees before the parcel is released.

Express International is delivered by courier with full tracking and usually arrives in 3 to 5 business days. For Express International orders shipped to the United Kingdom, Lumivane pays the import duties and VAT on your behalf, so nothing further is due on delivery. Express International rates are calculated at checkout from the parcel's weight and dimensions.

Glass shades over 50 cm in diameter can only be sent by Express International because of the risk of breakage in postal networks. Bulbs containing mercury, including compact fluorescent bulbs, cannot be shipped outside the United States.

We cannot change the shipping address once an international order has been handed to the carrier. Please double-check your postcode and include a phone number, as couriers in many countries need one to contact you about customs.

gold.target_claim: For Economy International orders shipped to the United Kingdom, Lumivane pays the import duties and VAT.

gold_spans.quote: For Express International orders shipped to the United Kingdom, Lumivane pays the import duties and VAT on your behalf

sources.text:

It does not cover commercial use, damage from improper installation, power surges, or cosmetic damage reported more than 30 days after delivery. Replacement water filters and light bulbs are consumable parts and are not covered.

sources.title: Fennick Protection Plus Service Plans
sources.text:
Fennick Protection Plus is an optional service plan that you can buy for any Fennick appliance at any time while its original limited warranty is still active. Plans are available in 3-year and 5-year terms, and each term begins on the day the plan is purchased.

question: Where does Sablewick's email delivery subprocessor process data?
answer: Pellinor Mail Relay processes Sablewick Chat data in Ireland and Germany.

sources.title: Sablewick Chat - Message retention settings
sources.text:
By default, Sablewick Chat keeps every message and file for as long as the workspace exists. Workspace owners on the Business and Enterprise plans can set a retention period instead, after which messages and files are deleted automatically.

Retention periods can be set for the whole workspace or, on Enterprise, separately for public channels, private channels and direct messages. The shortest period available is 1 day and the longest is 10 years. When a message reaches the end of its retention period, it is removed from search results immediately and deleted from storage within 7 days.

Changes to retention settings apply to existing messages as well as new ones, so shortening a retention period can delete a large amount of history at once. Owners see a confirmation screen showing how many messages will be affected before the change is saved.

sources.title: Sablewick Chat - Subprocessors
sources.text:
Sablewick uses the following subprocessors to provide Sablewick Chat. Each subprocessor is bound by a written agreement that requires it to protect customer data to at least the standard set out in our Data Processing Addendum.

Pellinor Cloud Services - infrastructure hosting for message storage and search indexes. Processing locations: Ireland and Germany.
Pellinor Mail Relay - delivery of notification and invitation emails. Processing location: United States.
Tarrow Systems - support ticketing for administrators who contact our help desk. Processing location: Canada.
Quillon Voice - transcription of voice notes when the transcription feature is turned on. Processing locations: Ireland and the Netherlands.

We give customers at least 30 days' notice before adding a subprocessor that will process message content. Notice is posted on this page and emailed to administrators who have subscribed to subprocessor updates.

gold.target_claim: Pellinor Mail Relay processes Sablewick Chat data in Ireland and Germany.

gold_spans.quote: Pellinor Cloud Services - infrastructure hosting for message storage and search indexes. Processing locations: Ireland and Germany.
Pellinor Mail Relay - delivery of notification and invitation emails. Processing location: United States.

construction.note: Ireland and Germany are the locations of the similarly named Pellinor Cloud Services; S2 gives Pellinor Mail Relay a different location (United States), so the claim is contradicted.

question: Who carries out Orrinvale's annual card-security assessment?
answer: Ostwyn Security carries out Orrinvale's annual card-security assessment.

sources.title: Orrinvale Payments - Card-security compliance overview
sources.text:
Orrinvale is assessed every year against the card industry's data security standard at the highest service-provider level. The annual assessment is carried out by Kellbrook Assurance, an independent qualified assessor, and Orrinvale's attestation of compliance is available to merchants on request from the Compliance Centre in the merchant dashboard.

Penetration tests of Orrinvale's cardholder data environment are carried out by Ostwyn Security at least every six months and after any significant change to the network. Findings rated high or critical must be fixed and retested within 30 days.

Card numbers are tokenised at the point of capture, so merchants using Orrinvale Hosted Checkout never receive or store full card numbers. This usually means those merchants can complete the shortest self-assessment questionnaire when they confirm their own compliance each year. Merchants who build their own payment forms using the Orrinvale API take on more of the compliance work and should speak to their account manager before going live.

sources.title: Orrinvale Payments - Security incident notification commitments
sources.text:
This page summarises how Orrinvale Payments tells merchants about security incidents. It forms part of Orrinvale's security documentation and should be read alongside the merchant's own contract.

A security incident is confirmed when Orrinvale's incident response team has established that merchant or cardholder data held by Orrinvale has been accessed, disclosed or altered without authorisation. Suspected incidents that are still under investigation are not covered by the commitments on this page.

For merchants on an Orrinvale Enterprise contract, Orrinvale will notify the merchant of a confirmed security incident affecting their data within 24 hours. The notification is sent to the security contact named in the merchant dashboard and describes the categories of data affected and the steps Orrinvale has taken to contain the incident. Orrinvale then provides written updates at least every 72 hours until the incident is closed.

Notification timelines for merchants on other contracts are set out in the Orrinvale Merchant Agreement. Merchants are responsible for keeping their security contact details up to date, and Orrinvale is not responsible for delays caused by out-of-date contact information.

sources.title: Orrinvale Payments - Vulnerability disclosure programme
sources.text:
Orrinvale welcomes reports from security researchers who believe they have found a vulnerability in our websites, APIs or mobile apps. Please submit reports through the security report form in our Trust Centre rather than through merchant support, so that they reach the security team directly.

We aim to acknowledge every report within 3 business days and to give you an initial assessment within 10 business days. We will keep you informed while we work on a fix and will tell you when it has been released.

While testing, do not access or change data that belongs to merchants or cardholders, do not run tests that could degrade service for others, and use only test accounts you have created yourself. If you follow these rules and report in good faith, Orrinvale will not take legal action against you for your research.

Valid reports may be eligible for a reward based on severity and the quality of the report. Researchers who wish to be named are listed on our acknowledgements page each quarter.

question: When did Halvicor detect the claims storage misconfiguration?
answer: Halvicor's security team detected the claim storage misconfiguration on 4 June 2026.

sources.title: Halvicor Mutual - How long we keep claims information
sources.text:
We keep the information connected with a claim for as long as we need it to handle the claim, deal with any complaint and meet our legal and regulatory obligations.

Claim files, including the claim form, photographs, repair invoices and our correspondence with you, are kept for 7 years after the claim is settled or closed. Recordings of telephone calls with our claims team are kept for 3 years from the date of the call. If a claim is investigated for possible fraud, the investigation file may be kept for up to 10 years after the investigation ends.

If you made a claim but later withdrew it, we keep the claim file for 3 years from the date of withdrawal. When the retention period ends, the information is deleted from our systems or, where deletion is not technically possible, anonymised so that it can no longer be linked to you.

sources.title: Halvicor Mutual - Recognising genuine messages from us
sources.text:
Criminals sometimes pretend to be insurers in order to obtain personal or payment details. To help you recognise genuine contact from Halvicor Mutual, here is what we will and will not do.

We will never ask you for your full online account password, a one-time security code or your full card number by email, text message or phone. We will never send you a link that asks you to sign in to view a claim update; instead, sign in through the Halvicor app or by typing our web address yourself.

Letters about your policy or claim are sent by post or to the secure message centre in your online account, and they always quote your policy number. If you receive a message that you are unsure about, do not reply to it. Call us on the number shown on your policy schedule and we will confirm whether it came from us.

sources.title: Halvicor Mutual - Notice of a data security incident affecting claim documents
sources.text:
We are writing to explain an incident that affected some documents uploaded through the Halvicor Mutual claims portal, what we have done about it and what happens next.

What happened. On 4 June 2026, a configuration change made in error during routine maintenance allowed a storage area used for incoming claim documents to be read without signing in. Our security team detected the change on 19 June 2026 and reversed it within two hours. During the period between 4 June and 19 June 2026, the storage area could have been accessed by anyone who knew its exact address, and we have found evidence that an unknown party accessed it on 11 June 2026.

What information was involved. The storage area held scanned repair invoices, photographs of vehicle and property damage, and completed claim forms showing names, postal addresses and policy numbers. It did not hold payment card or bank account details.

What we are doing. By 31 July 2026, Halvicor will write to every policyholder who uploaded a claim document between 4 June and 19 June 2026. Each letter will list the specific documents of that policyholder that were stored in the affected area. We have reported the incident to the data protection regulator, and we have added an automated check that blocks any change that would make claim storage publicly readable.

gold.target_claim: Halvicor's security team detected the claim storage misconfiguration on 4 June 2026.

gold_spans.quote: Our security team detected the change on 19 June 2026 and reversed it within two hours.

construction.note: Reuses the s7-f6 passages. 4 June 2026 is when the faulty change was made; S3 states detection happened on 19 June 2026, so the detection date is contradicted.

question: How long does Paceharbor keep my workout location history?
answer: Paceharbor retains workout location history for 12 months.

sources.title: Paceharbor Help Centre - How long is my route history kept?
sources.text:
Your route history is what lets you look back at where you ran, rode or walked. Paceharbor keeps your workout location history for 24 months. When a route reaches that age it is removed automatically, but the summary of the workout - distance, duration and date - stays in your training log.

If you want to keep a route for longer, you can export it as a GPX file from the workout's menu before it is removed. Exported files are stored on your own device and are not affected by the retention period.

Routes from workouts you have deleted are removed straight away and cannot be exported afterwards, so export anything you want to keep before deleting a workout. If you think a route has been removed by mistake, contact us from the Help menu and include the date of the workout.

sources.title: Paceharbor - Sharing workouts with followers
sources.text:
Every workout you record in Paceharbor has its own visibility setting: Only me, Followers or Everyone. New accounts start with Followers as the default, and you can change the default under Settings > Privacy.

Followers can see the workouts you share with them in their feed, together with your route map, distance, pace and any photos you add. They cannot see your heart-rate data unless you switch on Share health metrics for that workout.

If you set a workout to Everyone, it can appear on public leaderboards for the segments you completed. You can remove yourself from all leaderboards at once by turning off Leaderboard participation, which also hides your name on segment pages. People you remove from your followers are not notified.

sources.title: Paceharbor - Privacy policy (extract): location data
sources.text:
Paceharbor collects precise location data from your phone while you are recording a workout, so that we can map your route and calculate distance, pace and elevation. We do not collect location data when no workout is being recorded.

Route maps are visible only to you unless you choose to share a workout with followers or make it public. You can hide the start and end of your routes by setting a privacy zone of 200, 500 or 1,000 metres around any address.

We retain workout location history for 12 months, after which route data is deleted and only the workout's total distance, duration and date are kept. Deleting a workout removes its route data immediately. You can download a copy of all the location data we hold about you at any time from Settings > Privacy > Download my data.

gold_spans.quote: We retain workout location history for 12 months
Paceharbor keeps your workout location history for 24 months.

construction.note: The privacy policy says 12 months and the help article says 24 months for the same history; neither is dated or says it replaces the other, and both were retrieved the same day, so the evidence cannot settle the answer.

question: How long do deleted files stay in the Lumivane Docs trash?
answer: Deleted files remain in the Lumivane Docs trash for 30 days before they are permanently deleted.

sources.title: Lumivane Docs - Deleted files and the trash
sources.text:
When you delete a file in Lumivane Docs, it moves to the trash instead of being removed straight away, so that you can change your mind. Files in the trash do not count towards your workspace's storage quota and do not appear in search results.

Deleted files remain in the trash for 30 days. After that, they are permanently deleted and cannot be recovered by you, by your workspace administrator or by Lumivane support.

To restore a file, open Trash from the sidebar, select the file and choose Restore. The file returns to the folder it was deleted from, or to your home folder if that folder no longer exists. Workspace administrators can also restore files from any member's trash using the admin console.

If you need to remove a file immediately, for example because it was shared by mistake, you can choose Delete forever from the trash.

sources.text:

Version history now shows which member made each change and lets you name important versions so they are easier to find.

question: Where does Arventa Labs process Kestrove Read recordings?
answer: Arventa Labs processes Kestrove Read pupil recordings in the United Kingdom [S2].

sources.title: Kestrove Read - Privacy notice for schools: pupil voice recordings
sources.text:
Kestrove Read lets pupils record themselves reading a passage aloud so that their teacher can follow how their fluency develops over the year. This section of our privacy notice explains what happens to those recordings.

Recordings are stored in encrypted form in Kestrove's data centre in the United Kingdom. They are linked to the pupil's school account and are never connected to a personal email address or phone number.

Pupil recordings are sent to Kestrove's speech-scoring subprocessor, Arventa Labs, when the school has switched on automated fluency scoring. Arventa Labs uses each recording only to return a words-correct-per-minute score and a list of misread words to the teacher, and it must delete the audio within 72 hours of returning the score. Arventa Labs processes recordings in the United Kingdom and may not transfer them elsewhere.

Recordings held by Kestrove are deleted at the end of the school year in which they were made, unless the teacher has added them to the pupil's progress portfolio. Portfolio recordings are deleted when the pupil leaves the school or when the school's subscription ends, whichever happens first.

sources.title: Kestrove - Data processing terms for schools: summary
sources.text:
When a school uses Kestrove Read, the school is the controller of pupil data and Kestrove acts as its processor. Kestrove processes pupil data only on the school's documented instructions, which are set out in the order form and in the settings the school chooses in the admin console.

Kestrove staff who can access pupil data are bound by confidentiality obligations and complete safeguarding training every year. If Kestrove becomes aware of a personal data breach affecting pupil data, it will notify the school's nominated contact without undue delay and in any case within 48 hours.

Schools may audit Kestrove's compliance once per year by giving 30 days' written notice, or may instead rely on Kestrove's most recent independent security report. Kestrove will tell schools at least 30 days before it adds or replaces a subprocessor, and a school may object by contacting its account manager.

sources.title: Kestrove Read - Setting up classes and pupil accounts
sources.text:
Before pupils can use Kestrove Read, a school administrator needs to create classes and pupil accounts. Most schools do this by connecting Kestrove to their management information system, which copies across class lists each night. Schools without a connection can upload a spreadsheet containing each pupil's first name, last initial, year group and class.

Pupils do not need an email address. Instead, each pupil signs in by choosing their class and then picking their own picture password from a grid of nine images. Teachers can print sign-in cards for younger pupils and can reset a picture password from the class page at any time.

When a pupil moves class during the year, their reading history moves with them. When a pupil leaves the school, the administrator should archive their account so that it no longer counts towards the school's licence.

gold.target_claim: Arventa Labs processes Kestrove Read pupil recordings in the United Kingdom.

gold_spans.quote: Arventa Labs processes recordings in the United Kingdom and may not transfer them elsewhere.

construction.note: Reuses the s7-f4 passages. The claim is supported by S1, but the answer cites S2 (the data processing terms summary), which never mentions Arventa Labs or a processing location.

question: How long does Quenmoor keep camera footage recorded in the second half of 2026?
answer: Quenmoor deletes road-facing camera footage recorded between 1 July 2026 and 31 December 2026 after 14 days.

sources.title: Quenmoor Fleet - Camera footage retention update
sources.text:
Quenmoor Fleet customers who use the DualView in-cab camera record two video streams: a road-facing stream that captures the view through the windscreen, and a driver-facing stream that captures the driver's seat. Footage is uploaded to Quenmoor's cloud only when a safety event is detected or a fleet manager requests a clip.

Following an agreement with the Drivers' Consultative Council, Quenmoor deletes driver-facing camera footage recorded between 1 July 2026 and 31 December 2026 after 14 days. Road-facing camera footage is unaffected by the agreement and is deleted after 45 days.

For footage recorded during the same period, fleet managers must enter a reason in the platform before they can open a driver-facing clip, and each viewing is listed in the driver's own activity history in the Quenmoor Driver app.

The Council will review the arrangement in November 2026, and Quenmoor will publish any changes that apply to footage recorded from 1 January 2027 onward. Customers do not need to change any settings; the deletion period is applied automatically to every fleet.

sources.title: Quenmoor Fleet - How safety events are detected
sources.text:
The DualView camera contains an accelerometer and a gyroscope that measure how the vehicle moves. Quenmoor treats a movement as a safety event when it crosses one of the thresholds below, which fleet managers can adjust on the Safety settings page.

Harsh braking: deceleration greater than 0.45 g for at least half a second.
Harsh acceleration: acceleration greater than 0.35 g for at least one second.
Sharp cornering: lateral force greater than 0.40 g.
Possible collision: any impact above 2.5 g.

When an event is detected, the camera saves a clip covering the 10 seconds before and the 10 seconds after the event and uploads it as soon as the vehicle has a mobile signal. Events normally appear on the fleet dashboard within 5 minutes. Drivers hear an in-cab chime for harsh braking and sharp cornering so that they can adjust straight away; no chime is played for possible collisions.

sources.title: Quenmoor Fleet - Location history
sources.text:
Quenmoor trackers record the vehicle's position every 30 seconds while the ignition is on, and every 30 minutes while the vehicle is parked. Positions are used to build trip records, show live vehicle locations on the map and calculate mileage for expense reports.

Raw position points are kept for 13 months. Trip summaries, which show the start and end address, distance and duration of each journey, are kept for 6 years so that fleets can meet tax and mileage record-keeping requirements.

Drivers of vehicles that are approved for personal use can switch on Private Mode from the Quenmoor Driver app outside their working hours. While Private Mode is on, the tracker records only the distance travelled, not the route or position. Fleet managers can see that Private Mode was used but cannot see where the vehicle went.

gold.target_claim: Quenmoor deletes road-facing camera footage recorded between 1 July 2026 and 31 December 2026 after 14 days.

gold_spans.quote: Quenmoor deletes driver-facing camera footage recorded between 1 July 2026 and 31 December 2026 after 14 days.
Road-facing camera footage is unaffected by the agreement and is deleted after 45 days.

construction.note: Swapped the driver-facing stream for the road-facing stream; S1 says road-facing footage is unaffected and deleted after 45 days, so the claim is contradicted.

Footage is uploaded to Quenmoor's cloud only when a safety event is detected or a fleet manager requests a clip.

Following an agreement with the Drivers' Consultative Council, Quenmoor deletes driver-facing camera footage recorded between 1 July 2026 and 31 December 2026 after 14 days. Road-facing camera footage is unaffected by the agreement and is deleted after 45 days.

For footage recorded during the same period, fleet managers must enter a reason in the platform before they can open a driver-facing clip, and each viewing is listed in the driver's own activity history in the Quenmoor Driver app.

The Council will review the arrangement in November 2026, and Quenmoor will publish any changes that apply to footage recorded from 1 January 2027 onward. Customers do not need to change any settings; the deletion period is applied automatically to every fleet.

sources.title: Quenmoor Fleet - How safety events are detected
sources.text:
The DualView camera contains an accelerometer and a gyroscope that measure how the vehicle moves. Quenmoor treats a movement as a safety event when it crosses one of the thresholds below, which fleet managers can adjust on the Safety settings page.

Harsh braking: deceleration greater than 0.45 g for at least half a second.
Harsh acceleration: acceleration greater than 0.35 g for at least one second.
Sharp cornering: lateral force greater than 0.40 g.
Possible collision: any impact above 2.5 g.

When an event is detected, the camera saves a clip covering the 10 seconds before and the 10 seconds after the event and uploads it as soon as the vehicle has a mobile signal. Events normally appear on the fleet dashboard within 5 minutes. Drivers hear an in-cab chime for harsh braking and sharp cornering so that they can adjust straight away; no chime is played for possible collisions.

sources.title: Quenmoor Fleet - Location history
sources.text:
Quenmoor trackers record the vehicle's position every 30 seconds while the ignition is on, and every 30 minutes while the vehicle is parked. Positions are used to build trip records, show live vehicle locations on the map and calculate mileage for expense reports.

Raw position points are kept for 13 months. Trip summaries, which show the start and end address, distance and duration of each journey, are kept for 6 years so that fleets can meet tax and mileage record-keeping requirements.

Drivers of vehicles that are approved for personal use can switch on Private Mode from the Quenmoor Driver app outside their working hours. While Private Mode is on, the tracker records only the distance travelled, not the route or position. Fleet managers can see that Private Mode was used but cannot see where the vehicle went.

question: Are pupil recordings in Kestrove Read shared with any third party?

sources.title: Kestrove Read - Privacy notice for schools: pupil voice recordings
sources.text:
Kestrove Read lets pupils record themselves reading a passage aloud so that their teacher can follow how their fluency develops over the year. This section of our privacy notice explains what happens to those recordings.

Recordings are stored in encrypted form in Kestrove's data centre in the United Kingdom. They are linked to the pupil's school account and are never connected to a personal email address or phone number.

Pupil recordings are sent to Kestrove's speech-scoring subprocessor, Arventa Labs, when the school has switched on automated fluency scoring. Arventa Labs uses each recording only to return a words-correct-per-minute score and a list of misread words to the teacher, and it must delete the audio within 72 hours of returning the score. Arventa Labs processes recordings in the United Kingdom and may not transfer them elsewhere.

Recordings held by Kestrove are deleted at the end of the school year in which they were made, unless the teacher has added them to the pupil's progress portfolio. Portfolio recordings are deleted when the pupil leaves the school or when the school's subscription ends, whichever happens first.

sources.title: Kestrove - Data processing terms for schools: summary
sources.text:
When a school uses Kestrove Read, the school is the controller of pupil data and Kestrove acts as its processor. Kestrove processes pupil data only on the school's documented instructions, which are set out in the order form and in the settings the school chooses in the admin console.

Kestrove staff who can access pupil data are bound by confidentiality obligations and complete safeguarding training every year. If Kestrove becomes aware of a personal data breach affecting pupil data, it will notify the school's nominated contact without undue delay and in any case within 48 hours.

Schools may audit Kestrove's compliance once per year by giving 30 days' written notice, or may instead rely on Kestrove's most recent independent security report. Kestrove will tell schools at least 30 days before it adds or replaces a subprocessor, and a school may object by contacting its account manager.

sources.title: Kestrove Read - Setting up classes and pupil accounts
sources.text:
Before pupils can use Kestrove Read, a school administrator needs to create classes and pupil accounts. Most schools do this by connecting Kestrove to their management information system, which copies across class lists each night. Schools without a connection can upload a spreadsheet containing each pupil's first name, last initial, year group and class.

Pupils do not need an email address. Instead, each pupil signs in by choosing their class and then picking their own picture password from a grid of nine images. Teachers can print sign-in cards for younger pupils and can reset a picture password from the class page at any time.

When a pupil moves class during the year, their reading history moves with them. When a pupil leaves the school, the administrator should archive their account so that it no longer counts towards the school's licence.

question: Does the Fenwick Premier account give me an extra checked bag on Aurel Air?
answer: Fenwick Premier customers get one additional checked bag of up to 23 kg on every Aurel Air flight.

sources.title: Fenwick Bank - Premier account travel benefits
sources.text:
Fenwick Premier is our top-tier current account for customers who travel often. It costs GBP 22 per month and includes worldwide family travel insurance, fee-free card spending abroad and access to our travel concierge.

Premier customers also receive complimentary Aurel Club membership for 12 months. To activate it, open the Benefits tab in the Fenwick app, choose Aurel Club and enter your existing membership number or create a new one. Points you earn during the complimentary period stay in your Aurel Club account even if you later close your Premier account.

Travel insurance covers trips of up to 31 days for the account holder, their partner and their dependent children under 23. Winter sports cover is included, and cover for longer trips can be bought as an upgrade.

Spending abroad on your Fenwick debit card carries no foreign transaction fee, and cash withdrawals abroad are fee-free up to GBP 500 per month.

sources.title: Aurel Air - Aurel Club membership tiers
sources.text:
Aurel Club is the loyalty programme of Aurel Air. Anyone aged 2 or over can join online, and members earn Aurel points on flights and on purchases with partner companies. There are three tiers: Blue, Silver and Gold.

Blue members earn 5 points per euro spent on Aurel Air fares and can spend points on flights, seat upgrades and extra bags.

Silver members earn 7 points per euro, receive priority check-in, and can choose a standard seat free of charge when they book.

Gold members earn 10 points per euro and receive priority check-in, priority boarding, lounge access at their departure airport, and one additional checked bag of up to 23 kg on every Aurel Air flight.

Tier status is reviewed once a year on your membership anniversary, based on the number of qualifying flights you took in the previous 12 months. Status offered through a partner follows the terms of that partner's offer.

question: How much does a lap infant pay on Gannet Air?
answer: A lap infant on a Gannet Air flight pays 10% of the adult fare for each flight.

sources.title: Gannet Air - Infant fare changes
sources.text:
Updated 1 April 2026: infant fares

From 1 April 2026, a lap infant pays a flat fare of EUR 30 per flight on short-haul routes and EUR 80 per flight on long-haul routes. This replaces the previous infant fare of 10% of the adult fare. Taxes that apply to infants are still charged on top of the flat fare.

We have made this change because the old percentage-based fare meant that families paid very different amounts for the same infant on the same flight, depending on when the adult ticket was bought. A flat fare is simpler to understand and is shown clearly at every step of booking.

Nothing else about travelling with an infant has changed. The infant baggage allowance, the pushchair rules and the way bassinets are requested remain exactly as described on our Flying with an infant page.

sources.title: Gannet Air - Flying with an infant
sources.text:
Last updated 15 September 2025

Children under 2 years old can travel on an adult's lap. Each adult can take one lap infant, and there can be no more than one lap infant in each row of three seats.

Infant fare: a lap infant pays 10% of the adult fare for each flight, plus any taxes that apply to infants. The infant fare includes one checked bag of up to 10 kg and one folding pushchair, which can be checked in at the gate.

If your child turns 2 before the return flight, you must buy a seat for the return journey at the child fare.

Bassinets are available on long-haul flights for infants weighing under 11 kg. Request one in Manage Booking at least 48 hours before departure; they are allocated in the order requested.

question: How heavy can my pet be to travel in the cabin with Corriemoor Airlines?
answer: On Corriemoor Airlines, a pet travelling in the cabin and its carrier together must weigh no more than 8 kg.

sources.title: Corriemoor Airlines - Special baggage FAQ
sources.text:
Can I bring my pet in the cabin?
Yes. Cats and small dogs are welcome in the cabin as long as the pet and its carrier together weigh no more than 10 kg. The carrier must be soft-sided, well ventilated and small enough to fit under the seat in front of you. Book your pet's place in Manage Booking, as space is limited on each flight.

Can I bring my bicycle?
Bicycles are carried as special baggage for EUR 60 per flight. Remove the pedals, turn the handlebars sideways, partly deflate the tyres and pack the bicycle in a bike box or bag.

Can I bring skis?
One pair of skis, one pair of poles and one pair of ski boots in a single bag count as one checked bag and travel within your normal allowance. If your fare has no checked allowance, the ski bag costs EUR 40 per flight.

Can I bring a musical instrument?
Instruments up to 118 cm long can travel in the cabin if you buy an extra seat for them.

sources.title: Corriemoor Airlines - Travelling with pets
sources.text:
Cats and small dogs can travel with you in the cabin on most Corriemoor Airlines flights. Your pet must stay in a ventilated, soft-sided carrier under the seat in front of you for the whole flight, and the carrier must measure no more than 45 x 30 x 25 cm.

The pet and its carrier together must weigh no more than 8 kg. Heavier pets must travel in the hold in a rigid kennel, or be sent as cargo.

Each passenger may bring one pet in the cabin, and we accept no more than four pets in the cabin on each flight, so add your pet to your booking as early as possible. The charge is EUR 55 per pet per flight.

Pets are not accepted in the cabin on flights scheduled to last longer than six hours. Assistance dogs travel free of charge and are not counted toward the limit of four pets per flight.

question: What overdraft fee does Kittering Bank charge?
answer: If you have opted in to overdraft coverage, Kittering Bank charges a $25 fee each time it pays an item that overdraws your account.

sources.title: Kittering Bank - Personal account fee guide
sources.text:
Last updated 4 August 2025

This guide lists the main fees for Kittering Everyday and Kittering Plus current accounts.

Monthly fees: the Everyday account has no monthly fee. The Plus account costs $9 per month, which is waived in any month in which you keep a minimum daily balance of $3,000.

Overdrafts: if you have opted in to overdraft coverage, we charge a $25 fee each time we pay an item that overdraws your account, up to three fees per business day. We do not charge an overdraft fee on items of $5 or less.

Returned items: if we return an item unpaid because you do not have enough money, we charge a $15 returned item fee.

Other fees: a replacement debit card costs $5, or $25 for express delivery. Outgoing domestic wire transfers cost $20 and outgoing international wire transfers cost $40. Incoming wires are free.

sources.title: Kittering Bank - Changes to overdraft fees
sources.text:
Updated 1 March 2026

From 1 March 2026, Kittering Bank has changed how overdraft fees work on Everyday and Plus accounts. We now charge a single flat overdraft fee of $10 for any business day on which your account ends the day overdrawn by more than $50, no matter how many items were paid. This replaces the $25 per-item overdraft fee described in our earlier fee guide.

We have also removed the returned item fee, so we no longer charge you anything when we return an item unpaid.

If your account stays overdrawn for 7 consecutive days, we will contact you to talk through your options. Overdraft coverage remains optional, and you can opt in or out at any time in the Kittering app or by calling us. Card payments at a till or online are still declined if you have not opted in to overdraft coverage.
